abstract: Scoring functions built with advanced deep learning algorithms have recently gained prominence in protein–ligand pose generation and binding affinity prediction for computational drug design. However, several shortcomings make it increasingly difficult to evaluate scoring functions for a specific task across studies. Transparent disclosure of training data, code and procedures is essential to permit reproducibility, reuse and independent scrutiny. Guarding against data leakage, sampling bias and flawed design is equally important. Meaningful comparisons of scoring functions also require common data splits, checks for run-to-run variability and performance baselines. Here we propose a set of guidelines to help the community identify the most promising methods for addressing these important problems. Ballester and Tran-Nguyen advocate for transparency in data, code and experimental procedures in the evaluation of protein–ligand predictions. They discuss good practices for preventing data leakage and bias, enabling fair, reproducible and meaningful comparisons across different scoring methods.

abstract: [Nucleic acids research] Shotgun metagenomes from complex environments such as soil uncover vast biodiversity. Yet most short reads produced by shotgun sequencing cannot be taxonomically or functionally annotated, as they lack a sufficiently comprehensive reference, obscuring the true structure and function of microbial communities. We introduce BBERT, a nucleotide large language model optimized for short reads. Testing on a large cohort of soil metagenomes, we found that BBERT identifies bacterial sequence syntax without relying on reference databases, enabling accurate assignment of taxonomic domain, coding potential, and reading frame directly from reads as short as 100 bp. BBERT is small and fast enough to analyze metagenomes using a modest GPU and can be used to convert short metagenomic reads directly to bacterial amino acid sequences for downstream applications. BBERT also improves de novo metagenomic assembly, reducing mismatches and gaps while accelerating runtime. Using metagenomes from wild legume nodules, we demonstrate that BBERT filtering improves bin quality while significantly accelerating de novo assembly. By providing fast, reference-free classification of short reads, BBERT unlocks large metagenomic archives for more accurate ecological and evolutionary analyses.
zh_abstract: [Nucleic Acids Research] 来自土壤等复杂环境的鸟枪法宏基因组揭示了巨大的生物多样性。然而，鸟枪法测序产生的大多数短读段无法进行分类学或功能注释，因为它们缺乏足够全面的参考，掩盖了微生物群落的真实结构和功能。我们介绍 BBERT，一种针对短读段优化的核苷酸大语言模型。在大型土壤宏基因组队列上测试时，我们发现 BBERT 在不依赖参考数据库的情况下识别细菌序列语法，能够直接从短至 100 bp 的读段中准确判定分类学域、编码潜力和阅读框。BBERT 足够小且快，可使用普通 GPU 分析宏基因组，并可用于将短宏基因组读段直接转换为细菌氨基酸序列以供下游应用。BBERT 还改进了宏基因组从头组装，在加速运行时间的同时减少错配和缺口。利用来自野生豆科植物根瘤的宏基因组，我们证明 BBERT 过滤可提高 bin 质量，同时显著加速从头组装。通过提供快速、无参考的短读段分类，BBERT 为更准确的生态学和进化分析解锁了大型宏基因组档案。

abstract: [Nature genetics] Characterizing noncoding variant function remains an important challenge in human genetics. Genomic deep learning models have emerged as a promising approach to enable in silico prediction of variant effects. These models include supervised sequence-to-activity models, which predict molecular phenotypes such as genome-wide chromatin states or gene expression levels directly from DNA sequence, and self-supervised genomic language models. Here we review progress in leveraging these models for noncoding variant effect prediction. We describe practical considerations for making such predictions and categorize the types of ground-truth data used to evaluate variant effect predictions, providing insight into the settings in which current models are most useful. Our Review highlights key considerations for practitioners and opportunities for improvement in model development and evaluation.
zh_abstract: [Nature genetics] 表征非编码变异功能仍然是人类遗传学中的一个重要挑战。基因组深度学习模型已成为一种有前景的方法，能够实现变异效应的计算机（in silico）预测。这些模型包括监督式序列到活性模型（sequence-to-activity models），其直接从 DNA 序列预测分子表型，如全基因组染色质状态或基因表达水平；以及自监督基因组语言模型（genomic language models）。在此，我们综述了利用这些模型进行非编码变异效应预测的进展。我们描述了进行此类预测的实用考量，并对用于评估变异效应预测的真值数据（ground-truth data）类型进行了分类，从而深入说明当前模型最有用的应用场景。本综述强调了实践者的关键考量以及模型开发与评估方面的改进机会。

abstract: Automated radiology report generation for multi-sequence brain MRI holds strong promise for alleviating radiologists' workload, yet it remains a demanding problem: brain MRI studies are inherently volumetric, each pulse sequence carries complementary diagnostic information, and annotated data are critically scarce for low-resource clinical languages. Existing brain MRI-report resources are still dominated by English reports, translated clinical text, or datasets adapted from task-specific imaging benchmarks, leaving routine low-resource clinical reporting and heterogeneous multi-sequence MRI protocols insufficiently represented. To bridge this gap, we introduce ViBMR, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports, comprising 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series across T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences. Building on ViBMR, we establish a comprehensive evaluation setup for brain MRI report generation, covering representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies. The results provide key insights into dataset characteristics and model behavior, while demonstrating the necessity of native low-resource clinical datasets for reliable Vietnamese-origin brain MRI report generation. Our dataset and baseline models will be released for non-commercial research.
zh_abstract: 用于多序列脑 MRI 的自动放射学报告生成在减轻放射科医生工作负担方面具有很大前景，但仍是一个要求很高的问题：脑 MRI 研究本质上是体积性的，每个脉冲序列携带互补的诊断信息，而且对于低资源临床语言，标注数据极为稀缺。现有的脑 MRI-报告资源仍以英语报告、翻译的临床文本或改编自任务特定影像基准的数据集为主，导致常规低资源临床报告和异构多序列 MRI 方案的代表性不足。为弥合这一差距，我们推出 ViBMR，据我们所知，这是首个与常规越南语临床报告配对的大规模多序列脑 MRI 数据集，包含 3,649 名患者和 11,875 个 MRI 序列，涵盖 T1、T2、FLAIR 和增强 T1 序列。基于 ViBMR，我们建立了一个用于脑 MRI 报告生成的综合评估设置，涵盖代表性医学视觉-语言模型、多序列输入和特征聚合策略。结果提供了关于数据集特征和模型行为的关键见解，同时证明了原生低资源临床数据集对于可靠的越南语来源脑 MRI 报告生成的必要性。我们的数据集和基线模型将发布用于非商业研究。

title: Expandable Modality Experts for Medical Vision-Language Learning

summary: 提出可扩展模态专家库的医学视觉语言方法，用1940万张无配对图像与323万图文对预训练。
key_points: 多路Transformer共享视觉计算并路由模态专家

abstract: Learning across medical imaging modalities requires making use of images without paired text and accommodating new domains while retaining existing representations. We propose a medical vision-language technique built around an expandable bank of modality experts. Its Multiway Transformer combines shared visual computation with deterministically routed feed-forward experts and a separate text pathway. A modality-aware visual tokenizer supplies targets for masked pretraining on 19.4 million unpaired image rows across seven modalities; contrastive alignment then uses 3.23 million image-text pairs. Additional fundus and optical coherence tomography experts learn from paired data while the original image and text embedding paths remain frozen. With a ViT-Large backbone, the proposed technique achieves the best or tied-best result in 24 of 25 benchmark settings across nine modalities: 10 of 11 zero-shot classification benchmarks, all 10 linear probes, and all four retrieval benchmarks. Mean balanced accuracy is 0.674 for zero-shot classification and 0.856 for linear probing, and mean bidirectional retrieval recall is 20.70%. A separate three-seed sequential experiment with matched adaptation data yields fundus and OCT retrieval gains of 14.95 and 9.31 percentage points, with no measured loss on preceding fundus or pathology tasks. The preservation argument requires unchanged existing computation paths and inference conditions, and feature-identity checks verify retention on evaluated inputs. The proposed technique provides a modular approach to learning and expanding medical vision-language representations.
zh_abstract: 跨医学影像模态的学习需要利用没有配对文本的图像，并在保留现有表示的同时适应新域。我们提出一种医学视觉-语言技术，其构建围绕可扩展的模态专家库。其Multiway Transformer将共享视觉计算与确定性路由的前馈专家以及单独的文本通路相结合。模态感知视觉分词器为跨七个模态的1940万条未配对图像行上的掩码预训练提供目标；随后对比对齐使用323万对图像-文本对。额外的眼底和光学相干断层扫描（OCT）专家从配对数据中学习，而原始图像和文本嵌入路径保持冻结。以ViT-Large为骨干，所提技术在九个模态的25个基准设置中有24个取得最佳或并列最佳结果：11个零样本分类基准中的10个、全部10个线性探针以及全部4个检索基准。零样本分类的平均平衡准确率为0.674，线性探针为0.856，平均双向检索召回率为20.70%。一项使用匹配适应数据的独立三随机种子序贯实验在眼底和OCT检索上分别获得14.95和9.31个百分点的提升，且在先前的眼底或病理任务上未测得损失。保留性论证要求现有计算路径和推理条件保持不变，特征同一性检查验证在评估输入上的保留。所提技术为学习和扩展医学视觉-语言表示提供了一种模块化方法。

abstract: [JMIR formative research] Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive molecular subtype of breast cancer that needs to be identified accurately from pathology reports to inform decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) have been reported to show great potential in the automatic extraction of important oncology information from unstructured medical text. We aimed to create and test an LLM-based approach for automatic biomarker extraction and TNBC subtype classification based on breast cancer pathology reports using prompt-engineering techniques. In total, 532 breast cancer pathology reports from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) were used. Our approach extracted structured oncology features, such as estrogen receptor status, progesterone receptor status, HER2 status, tumor size, tumor grade, and tumor histology, which were used to identify TNBC. We tested 4 frontier models: GPT-4o mini (released July 18, 2024), GPT-4.1 nano (released April 14, 2025), GPT-5 nano (released August 7, 2025), and Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite. The designed framework was able to extract relevant biomarkers and clinicopathological attributes from unstructured pathology reports and allowed for the automated identification of patients with TNBC. Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite showed superior performance in the extraction of clinicopathological attributes. For all models investigated, chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting was shown to outperform other strategies, such as zero-shot and few-shot prompting, for both biomarker extraction and TNBC classification. GPT-4o mini using CoT prompts reported the highest performance for TNBC classification. Using prompt-engineering techniques based on LLMs proved to be an efficient method of translating unstructured breast cancer pathology reports into structured clinical information. Moreover, it can be used to accurately identify the TNBC subtype.
zh_abstract: [JMIR formative research] 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是乳腺癌的一种侵袭性分子亚型，需要从病理报告中准确识别以指导决策。据报道，大语言模型（LLMs）在从非结构化医学文本中自动提取重要肿瘤学信息方面显示出巨大潜力。我们旨在创建并测试一种基于 LLM 的方法，利用提示工程（prompt-engineering）技术，基于乳腺癌病理报告自动提取生物标志物并进行 TNBC 亚型分类。总共使用了来自癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）的 532 份乳腺癌病理报告。我们的方法提取了结构化肿瘤学特征，如雌激素受体状态、孕激素受体状态、HER2 状态、肿瘤大小、肿瘤分级和肿瘤组织学，这些特征用于识别 TNBC。我们测试了 4 个前沿模型：GPT-4o mini（2024 年 7 月 18 日发布）、GPT-4.1 nano（2025 年 4 月 14 日发布）、GPT-5 nano（2025 年 8 月 7 日发布）和 Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite。所设计的框架能够从非结构化病理报告中提取相关生物标志物和临床病理属性，并能够自动识别 TNBC 患者。Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite 在提取临床病理属性方面表现出更优性能。对于所有研究的模型，在生物标志物提取和 TNBC 分类方面，思维链（CoT）提示均被证明优于其他策略，如零样本和少样本提示。使用 CoT 提示的 GPT-4o mini 在 TNBC 分类方面报告了最高性能。使用基于 LLM 的提示工程技术被证明是将非结构化乳腺癌病理报告转化为结构化临床信息的有效方法。此外，它可用于准确识别 TNBC 亚型。

abstract: [European journal of oral sciences] This systematic review provides a broad overview of three distinct applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in facial soft-tissue assessment: landmark localization, automated facial measurement, and classification of soft-tissue conditions in orthodontic and dentofacial evaluation. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, ClinicalTrials.gov, Google Scholar, and Open Science Framework were searched. Studies using 2D facial photographs, 3D facial scans, or AI-generated facial models were included. Risk of bias was assessed with an adapted QUADAS-2 tool and certainty of evidence with GRADE. The protocol was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261452521). Fifteen studies were included. Landmark-localization performance varied substantially by imaging modality, landmark definition, data set, reference standard, and error metric; central and anatomically well-defined landmarks were generally more accurate than peripheral or subjective points. Agreement for AI-derived measurements ranged from poor to excellent, with ICCs of approximately 0.01-0.984. Classification accuracy ranged from approximately 0.83 to 0.98, with AUCs up to 0.98. Given only two narrowly scoped classification studies, these findings should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than broadly generalizable. Because of substantial methodological heterogeneity, findings were synthesized qualitatively. Current evidence supports AI as an adjunctive tool, but routine clinical implementation requires robust external validation and clinician oversight. PROSPERO registration: CRD420261452521.

abstract: [Radiological physics and technology] In Gamma Knife stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS), achieving optimal dosimetric outcomes is physically constrained by complex tumor geometry. While the Gradient Index (GI) and Conformity Index (CI) define plan quality, the volume receiving [Formula: see text] and Shot Density dictate patient safety and efficiency. Current volumetric heuristics fail to capture the topological irregularities that govern these parameters. This study introduces a physics-aware Geometric Deep Learning framework to simultaneously predict quality, safety, and complexity metrics directly from surface topology. Methods: Utilizing the Vestibular-Schwannoma-SEG dataset [Formula: see text], tumor manifolds were converted into physics-aware point clouds enriched with 12-dimensional feature vectors, including surface normals and radial curvature. A multi-task PointNet-based architecture, termed "GammaPoint-Net," was developed to regress GI, CI, [Formula: see text], and Shot Density. The framework was benchmarked against 3D Voxel-based CNNs, standard volumetric regression, conventional machine-learning regressors trained on handcrafted 3D shape descriptors (Random Forest, Support Vector Regression, and XGBoost), and point-based architectures using 5-fold cross-validation. GammaPoint-Net achieved superior predictive accuracy across all objectives ([Formula: see text]), significantly outperforming volumetric baselines [Formula: see text]. Ablation studies confirmed that incorporating differential geometric features reduced the mean absolute error by 46%. GammaPoint-Net also outperformed the strongest handcrafted shape-descriptor baseline (XGBoost augmented with curvature moments, [Formula: see text]; paired Wilcoxon [Formula: see text] ). Saliency mapping demonstrated that the network autonomously identifies high-curvature surface protrusions as the primary drivers of dosimetric degradation. GammaPoint-Net demonstrates that surface topology, rather than volume, is the fundamental determinant of radiosurgical plan quality. This framework provides an instantaneous, interpretable pre-planning assessment, enabling physicists to anticipate plan difficulty and toxicity risks prior to optimization.

abstract: [Australian dental journal] This review scoped artificial intelligence (AI) in paediatric dentistry to summarize current applications and limitations. A comprehensive literature search was completed across PubMed, Google Scholar, Scopus, Embase, IEEE Xplore, and medRxiv/aArXiv. The preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) checklist was used for reporting the present study. Studies concerning paediatric dentistry and utilizing AI, machine learning (ML) or large language models (LLMs) were included. Two independent reviewers screened and three extracted data on AI methodologies, performance metrics, and clinical applications. Fifty-nine studies were included. Computer vision studies (n = 32) most often used panoramic radiographs (n = 14), mainly for tooth detection, numbering and segmentation (n = 10) and caries detection (n = 9). Non-imaging ML studies (n = 18) primarily used clinical variables and questionnaire data (n = 8) or salivary/biological samples (n = 10). Accuracy ranged from 50% to 100%, with sensitivity reaching 100% in biomarker-based studies. LLM accuracy varied widely (33%-96%). Computer vision and non-imaging ML show promise for paediatric dentistry, particularly in the detection of dental structures and diseases, as well as risk stratification. Variable LLM performance underscores the need for standardized evaluation before clinical integration. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: AI-based tools may support paediatric dentists by improving tooth detection, dental structure assessment, caries detection, disease prediction and risk stratification. Computer vision and non-imaging machine learning approaches appear to have potential, but their clinical value depends on robust external validation, transparent reporting and integration into paediatric dental workflows. Given their variable performance, AI tools should be used only as adjunctive tools or a second reviewer.
zh_abstract: [Australian dental journal] 本综述对人工智能（AI）在儿童牙科中的应用进行了范围界定，以总结当前应用与局限性。我们在 PubMed、Google Scholar、Scopus、Embase、IEEE Xplore 和 medRxiv/aArXiv 上完成了全面文献检索。本研究报告采用范围综述的系统综述和荟萃分析首选报告条目扩展版（PRISMA-ScR）清单。纳入涉及儿童牙科并使用 AI、机器学习（ML）或大语言模型（LLMs）的研究。两名独立评审者进行筛选，三名评审者提取 AI 方法、性能指标和临床应用数据。共纳入 59 项研究。计算机视觉研究（n = 32）最常使用全景X线片（n = 14），主要用于牙齿检测、编号和分割（n = 10）以及龋齿检测（n = 9）。非影像 ML 研究（n = 18）主要使用临床变量和问卷数据（n = 8）或唾液/生物样本（n = 10）。准确率范围为 50% 至 100%，在基于生物标志物的研究中灵敏度达到 100%。LLM 准确率差异很大（33%-96%）。计算机视觉和非影像 ML 在儿童牙科中显示出前景，特别是在牙科结构和疾病检测以及风险分层方面。LLM 性能不一，凸显了在临床整合前进行标准化评估的必要性。【临床意义】基于 AI 的工具可能通过改善牙齿检测、牙科结构评估、龋齿检测、疾病预测和风险分层来支持儿童牙科医生。计算机视觉和非影像机器学习方法似乎具有潜力，但其临床价值取决于稳健的外部验证、透明报告以及整合到儿童牙科工作流程中。鉴于其性能不一，AI 工具应仅作为辅助工具或第二复核者使用。

title: Generative AI in clinical practice: how should rheumatologists evaluate and monitor emerging tools?

abstract: [Arthritis care & research] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being used in rheumatology practice, to assist with tasks such as documentation, record summarization, and clinical decision support. Rheumatologists need a practical approach to determining what evidence and oversight each application requires. This narrative review proposes a framework based on two dimensions: contextual complexity and influence on patient care. Greater contextual complexity can make errors harder to detect, whereas greater influence on care increases the potential consequences of an undetected error. We examine evidence for workflow benefits and clinical effectiveness within this framework and consider safety, equity, privacy, governance, and implementation. Existing evidence on the benefits, accuracy and reliability of AI applications remains mixed. For example, studies of ambient AI scribes suggest reduced documentation burden, but evidence of improved patient outcomes from applications supporting clinical decisions is more limited. For applications with limited clinical influence, evaluation has initially focused on workflow, usability, and documentation quality. Tools that synthesize longitudinal information require additional assessment of completeness and source traceability. Those influencing diagnosis or treatment require prospective evaluation of clinical benefit and safety. Relevant vendor evidence should be assessed alongside proportionate local testing and ongoing monitoring. Safeguards should address risks such as hallucinations, automation bias, and propagating documentation errors, with attention to performance across patient groups. Changes in functionality or clinical use should prompt reassessment. The framework provides a structured basis for adoption decisions and identifies priorities for research on patient outcomes and feasible oversight in routine rheumatology care.
zh_abstract: [Arthritis care & research] 生成式人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于风湿病学实践，以协助文档记录、病历摘要和临床决策支持等任务。风湿病学家需要一种实用的方法来判断每种应用需要何种证据和监督。本叙述性综述提出一个基于两个维度的框架：情境复杂性和对患者照护的影响。情境复杂性越高，越难发现错误；而对照护影响越大，未被发现错误的潜在后果越大。我们在此框架内审视有关工作流程获益和临床有效性的证据，并考虑安全性、公平性、隐私、治理和实施。关于AI应用获益、准确性和可靠性的现有证据仍不一致。例如，对环境AI记录员（ambient AI scribes）的研究提示可减轻记录负担，但支持临床决策的应用改善患者结局的证据较为有限。对于临床影响有限的应用，评价最初集中于工作流程、可用性和记录质量。综合纵向信息的工具需要对完整性和来源可追溯性进行额外评估。影响诊断或治疗的工具需要对临床获益和安全性进行前瞻性评价。相关厂商证据应与相称的本地测试和持续监测一并评估。防护措施应应对幻觉、自动化偏倚和传播记录错误等风险，并关注不同患者群体中的表现。功能或临床用途的变化应促使重新评估。该框架为采用决策提供结构化依据，并确定在常规风湿病照护中关于患者结局和可行监督的研究优先事项。

abstract: [Nature reviews. Genetics] Long-read sequencing enables accurate analysis of complex and repetitive genomic regions but has distinct error profiles compared to short-read sequencing. Consequently, the tools for calling small variants - the predominant source of human genetic diversity - have shifted towards deep learning-based methods. This transition has reshaped variant calling across biological contexts, including germline, de novo, somatic and mosaic variants, and sequencing modalities for capturing both DNA and RNA at different resolutions. These deep learning frameworks are being developed in combination with alignment-based, assembly-based and pangenome-based strategies for small variant detection. In this Review, we chart the trajectory towards complete telomere-to-telomere profiling of small variants and consider the computational innovations needed to benchmark newly accessible repetitive regions and complex variants.

Genetics] 长读长测序能够准确分析复杂和重复基因组区域，但与短读长测序相比具有不同的错误特征。因此，用于检测小变异——人类遗传多样性的主要来源——的工具已转向基于深度学习的方法。这一转变重塑了跨生物背景的变异检测，包括胚系、新发、体细胞和嵌合变异，以及在不同分辨率下捕获 DNA 和 RNA 的测序模式。这些深度学习框架正与基于比对、基于组装和基于泛基因组的小变异检测策略相结合进行开发。在本综述中，我们描绘了实现小变异完整端粒到端粒（telomere-to-telomere）分析的轨迹，并考虑了对新近可及的重复区域和复杂变异进行基准测试所需的计算创新。

title: Would an LLM Match into a Residency? Uncertainty, Reasoning and Image Use of Open Language Models on the Spanish MIR Examination

abstract: Accuracy on medical examinations is common evidence offered for the clinical use of language models, yet a health system that intends to run an open model on its own hardware needs to know considerably more: whether the model recognizes when it is likely to be wrong, whether medical fine-tuning improves this ability, whether its correct answers rest on sound clinical reasoning, or whether it actually uses the images it is given. We examine these questions for four open models of 8 to 27 billion parameters on the Spanish MIR residency examination, scoring 1,552 questions from eight editions under the exam's own rules. Answering every question, the three larger models would rank among roughly the first 600 to 3,000 candidates, with 41 to 43 specialties still open to them. Abstention, however, never pays, because even their least confident answers are right more often than the 25% break-even. Medical fine-tuning reduced overconfidence at the cost of accuracy, without improving how well confidence separates right from wrong answers. Moreover, 13-38% of correct answers rejected a distractor for a clinically unsound reason that confidence did not reflect, and removing or swapping the provided contextual images left accuracy unchanged.
zh_abstract: 医学考试上的准确率常被作为语言模型临床应用的证据，但一个打算在自有硬件上运行开放模型的卫生系统需要了解的内容要多得多：模型是否能识别自己可能出错，医学微调是否提升这种能力，其正确答案是否建立在可靠的临床推理上，或者它是否真的使用了所给的图像。我们在西班牙MIR住院医师考试上，对四个8至270亿参数的开放模型考察了这些问题，按照考试自身规则对八个版本的1,552道题进行评分。若回答每一道题，三个较大模型将位列大约前600至3,000名考生，仍有41至43个专科可选。然而，弃答从不划算，因为即使它们最不自信的答案，正确率也高于25%的盈亏平衡点。医学微调以准确率下降为代价降低了过度自信，却未改善置信度区分正确答案与错误答案的能力。此外，13-38%的正确答案以临床上不合理的理由排除了一个干扰项，而置信度并未反映这一点；移除或替换所提供的上下文图像后，准确率保持不变。

abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) models are often shared without their training data, assuming this protects the patients who contributed them. However, a model can reveal whether a patient's records were used in training, a privacy breach known as a membership inference attack. This risk is usually reported as a cohort average, which can appear negligible while individual patients are almost certainly exposed. Identifying potentially vulnerable records before developing a production model could make privacy assessment more practical. We measured each patient's vulnerability to membership inference attack, across 7,789 models trained on six clinical datasets in four modalities, including two adapted pretrained medical models. Training choices changed how many patients had high attack scores, but the patients who ranked highest by risk largely stayed the same across the configurations we tested. Stronger weight decay reduced the exposed cohort up to threefold, yet largely the same patients remained most at risk across training recipes, architectures and initializations, including foundation models. Therefore, we developed a lightweight screening tool that uses four small models to identify patients with high risk of exposure before production-model training. We also assessed if flagged patients could be protected without removing their data. Privacy screening should become incorporated into data preparation for clinical AI.
zh_abstract: 医学人工智能（AI）模型常在不共享其训练数据的情况下被共享，假设这样做可以保护贡献这些数据的患者。然而，模型可能泄露某位患者的记录是否被用于训练，这种隐私泄露被称为成员推断攻击（membership inference attack）。这一风险通常以队列平均值报告，这可能看起来可忽略不计，而个体患者却几乎肯定处于暴露状态。在开发生产模型之前识别可能脆弱的记录，可使隐私评估更具可操作性。我们在四个模态的六个临床数据集上训练的 7,789 个模型中，测量了每位患者对成员推断攻击的脆弱性，其中包括两个经适配的预训练医学模型。训练选择改变了有多少患者具有高攻击评分，但在我们测试的各种配置中，按风险排名最高的患者基本保持不变。更强的权重衰减使暴露队列最多减少至原来的三分之一，然而在训练方案、架构和初始化（包括基础模型）之间，基本仍是相同的患者处于最高风险。因此，我们开发了一种轻量级筛查工具，使用四个小模型在生产模型训练前识别具有高暴露风险的患者。我们还评估了被标记的患者是否可在不移除其数据的情况下受到保护。隐私筛查应纳入临床人工智能的数据准备工作中。

title: The Value of System 1 Models in Medicine
zh_title: System 1模型在医学任务中的零样本评测
summary: 在86项公开临床任务、14个领域和20种语言上零样本评测四种System 1模型。
key_points: 评测86项任务、14个临床领域
主结局为AUROC并评估校准
比较专有与开源模型及生成模型
reason: 大规模多任务零样本基准评测，但预印本且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Many clinical decisions are a choice among a few fixed options, taken quickly and in large numbers. Such decisions also need an uncertainty estimate to know when to defer to a clinician. Generative language models answer slowly in free text and state their confidence poorly. In contrast, System 1 models answer zero-shot with a probability for each answer. However, their performance across clinical tasks is unknown. Four System 1 models, two proprietary and two with open weights, were evaluated zero-shot on 86 public tasks from 14 clinical domains in 20 languages, spanning examination questions and medical imaging. Tasks were assigned to six capability tiers before analysis. The primary outcome was the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUROC). Secondary outcomes included calibration, language effects and comparisons with published results and generative models. Across 179,111 cases, the mean AUROC of the best model per task was 0.94 for medical knowledge, 0.93 for text understanding, 0.83 for clinical judgement from text, 0.89 for image perception, 0.84 for 2D image findings and 0.69 for volumetric findings. Imaging tasks scored 0.09 (95% CI, 0.06 to 0.11) lower than text tasks (P < 0.001). The best model matched or exceeded the best published result on 13 of 26 text tasks and on 8 of 35 imaging tasks. Triage nurses outperformed the best model (accuracy, 0.85 vs. 0.56). One decision took 0.34 to 0.44 seconds and 24 to 81 joules on open-weight models run locally. Accuracy on identical questions fell by up to 39 percentage points from English to Yoruba. Generative models of the same family were 11 to 76 times slower, with 3 to 5 percentage points higher balanced accuracy. System 1 models decide quickly, cheaply and with usable confidence when the answer is stated in a text or recalled from medical knowledge, but not when it must be judged or read from an image.
zh_abstract: 许多临床决策是在少数固定选项之间做出的选择，需要快速且大量地完成。此类决策还需要不确定性估计，以判断何时应转由临床医生处理。生成式语言模型以自由文本缓慢作答，并且对其置信度的表述很差。相比之下，System 1 模型以零样本方式作答，并为每个答案给出概率。然而，它们在临床任务中的表现尚不清楚。四个 System 1 模型（两个专有模型和两个开放权重模型）在来自 14 个临床领域、20 种语言的 86 项公开任务上进行了零样本评估，任务涵盖考试题和医学影像。分析前将任务分配到六个能力层级。主要结局是受试者工作特征曲线下面积（area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve, AUROC）。次要结局包括校准、语言效应，以及与已发表结果和生成式模型的比较。在 179,111 个病例中，每项任务最佳模型的平均 AUROC 在医学知识为 0.94、文本理解为 0.93、基于文本的临床判断为 0.83、图像感知为 0.89、2D 图像发现为 0.84、体积影像发现为 0.69。影像任务得分比文本任务低 0.09（95% CI，0.06 至 0.11）（P < 0.001）。最佳模型在 26 项文本任务中的 13 项和 35 项影像任务中的 8 项上达到或超过最佳已发表结果。分诊护士优于最佳模型（准确率，0.85 对 0.56）。在本地运行的开放权重模型上，一次决策耗时 0.34 至 0.44 秒，消耗 24 至 81 焦耳。相同问题的准确率从英语到约鲁巴语最多下降 39 个百分点。同一家族的生成式模型慢 11 至 76 倍，平衡准确率高 3 至 5 个百分点。当答案在文本中陈述或从医学知识中回忆时，System 1 模型决策快速、低成本且具有可用的置信度；但当必须从图像中判断或读取时则不然。

title: SIM-UT: A User Simulation based Evaluation Framework for Medical Triage Chatbots
zh_title: SIM-UT：面向医疗分诊聊天机器人的用户模拟评估框架
summary: 提出多轮模拟用户行为的评估框架SIM-UT，用于发现LLM分诊聊天机器人在低收入国家的真实失效模式。
key_points: 针对单轮、纯英文基准的评估缺陷
覆盖印度、南非等三款WhatsApp健康机器人
模拟拼写错误、方言与情绪化长文本输入
reason: 新评估方法并用于真实部署机器人，但为预印本且未报告临床结局
abstract: LLM-based chat agents are increasingly used for complex, multi-turn, multilingual medical triage in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet evaluation methods focus on single-turn, English-only benchmarks that primarily test the chatbots' knowledge. In practice, users are often confused, overwhelmed, or emotionally vulnerable, giving unclear, misspelled single-word answers or long messages in regional dialects, and the context of a conversation can shift rapidly. We propose SIM-UT (Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage), a multi-turn, simulation-based evaluation method that identifies ecologically valid, contextually relevant failure modes of LLM-based triage chat agents. Using SIM-UT, we evaluated three real-world WhatsApp-based health chatbots: a respiratory screening programme in India, a hearing health support programme in South Africa, and a diabetes and lifestyle coaching agent in Kenya. We compared a medically fine-tuned open model (MedGemma) against general-purpose frontier models (ChatGPT and Claude) across 5,000+ multilingual simulated conversation turns grounded in the personas, constraints, and communication patterns of the real user populations, over 2-4 iterative rounds. A key failure mode emerged in both model families: de-escalation risk. The agents initially identified medical emergencies correctly, but when the user minimised the symptoms without introducing new clinical information, they de-escalated, exhibiting clinically dangerous sycophancy, for example agreeing that vaginal bleeding in pregnancy was "not a problem" or that decreased fetal movements at 32 weeks "can be normal". We recommend user simulation-based behavioural evaluation, grounded in real user context and covering adversarial and edge cases, as standard practice for triage chatbots in production, so that safeguards can be added before deployment or in subsequent iterations.
zh_abstract: 基于 LLM 的聊天代理越来越多地用于低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）中复杂、多轮、多语言的医疗分诊，然而评估方法仍集中于单轮、仅英语的基准，主要测试聊天机器人的知识。在实践中，用户常常感到困惑、不堪重负或情绪脆弱，给出不清晰、拼写错误的单词回答或用地区方言写长消息，而且对话背景可能迅速变化。我们提出 SIM-UT（Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage，分诊用户行为模拟），一种多轮、基于模拟的评估方法，用于识别基于 LLM 的分诊聊天代理在生态上有效且与情境相关的失效模式。使用 SIM-UT，我们评估了三个真实世界的基于 WhatsApp 的健康聊天机器人：印度的一项呼吸系统筛查项目、南非的一项听力健康支持项目，以及肯尼亚的一个糖尿病和生活方式指导代理。我们将医学微调的开源模型（MedGemma）与通用前沿模型（ChatGPT 和 Claude）进行比较，覆盖 5,000 余个多语言模拟对话轮次，这些轮次基于真实用户群体的人物设定、约束条件和沟通模式，并经过 2-4 轮迭代。两个模型家族中都出现了一个关键失效模式：降级风险（de-escalation risk）。代理最初正确识别了医疗紧急情况，但当用户在没有引入新临床信息的情况下淡化症状时，它们便降级，表现出临床上危险的迎合行为，例如同意妊娠期阴道出血“不是问题”，或同意 32 周胎动减少“可以是正常的”。我们建议将基于用户模拟的行为评估作为生产中分诊聊天机器人的标准做法，该评估以真实用户情境为基础并覆盖对抗性和边缘案例，以便在部署前或后续迭代中添加保障措施。

title: nnInteractive Agent: General-Purpose AI Agents as 3D Image Annotators
zh_title: nnInteractive 智能体：通用 AI 智能体做 3D 图像标注
summary: 预印本提出无需额外训练的通用智能体，用自然语言理解分割目标、调用 nnInteractive、检查并修正 3D 结果，代码开源。
key_points: 用户以自然语言提出分割需求，智能体自行定位目标
智能体可调用 nnInteractive 并检视、修正 3D 结果
示例含咀嚼肌分割与肝病灶计数、自行写代码
提供开源 nninteractive-agent
reason: 有新意的智能体方法且开源，但为预印本、描述缺定量外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Interactive 3D segmentation models such as nnInteractive turn a few spatial prompts (points, scribbles, boxes) into accurate volumetric masks, but a human still does the annotation work: finding each structure, placing prompts, checking the result and correcting it. General-purpose AI agents can now interpret images, call tools and write code. We show that such agents can take over this work without additional training: the user makes a request in plain language, and the agent works out what has to be segmented, locates the targets, prompts nnInteractive, inspects the 3D result, corrects it and responds to feedback. Asked for 'the muscles used for chewing', an agent identifies and segments the masseters and pterygoids; asked to count liver lesions, it writes its own code to find candidates and splits a merged lesion on request. Our open-source nninteractive-agent provides nnInteractive as tools over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), together with a skill that encodes how experienced users prompt it. On a benchmark spanning CT, MRI, PET and micro-CT of humans, a mouse and an ant (14 images; 51 targets from organs and tumours to muscles, foot bones, vessel trees and an insect brain), Claude Code and Codex reach a mean Dice of 0.81 and 0.84 from the request alone; when told where each target is, both reach 0.85 and prompt nearly as effectively as an oracle that places prompts using the reference segmentation. A text-prompted 3D model (VoxTell) is more accurate on most standard radiological targets but less robust: it returns an empty mask for one of them and fails on the leg muscles, the foot bones, the mouse and the ant, where the agents remain accurate. Code: https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nninteractive-agent
zh_abstract: 交互式3D分割模型（如nnInteractive）可将少量空间提示（点、涂鸦、框）转化为准确的体积掩膜，但仍需人工完成标注工作：找到每个结构、放置提示、检查结果并进行纠正。通用AI智能体现在能够解释图像、调用工具并编写代码。我们表明，此类智能体无需额外训练即可接管这项工作：用户用自然语言提出请求，智能体确定需要分割的内容、定位目标、向nnInteractive提供提示、检查3D结果、纠正结果并响应反馈。当被要求“用于咀嚼的肌肉”时，智能体能识别并分割咬肌和翼肌；当被要求计数肝脏病灶时，它编写自己的代码寻找候选病灶，并按要求拆分一个融合病灶。我们的开源nninteractive-agent通过模型上下文协议（MCP）将nnInteractive作为工具提供，并附带一项编码有经验用户如何提示它的技能。在一个涵盖人类、小鼠和蚂蚁的CT、MRI、PET和micro-CT的基准上（14张图像；51个目标，从器官和肿瘤到肌肉、足骨、血管树和昆虫脑），仅凭请求，Claude Code和Codex达到平均Dice 0.81和0.84；当告知每个目标的位置时，两者均达到0.85，并且提示效果几乎与使用参考分割放置提示的oracle一样有效。文本提示的3D模型（VoxTell）在大多数标准放射学目标上更准确，但稳健性较差：它对其中一个目标返回空掩膜，并在腿部肌肉、足骨、小鼠和蚂蚁上失败，而智能体在这些情形下仍保持准确。代码：https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nninteractive-agent

title: Large language models show systematic failures in incorporating evolving medical knowledge
zh_title: 大模型在纳入演进医学知识上存在系统性失败
summary: 预印本构建 ChronoEvo（1709条推荐级别修订），14个模型识别修订率90.8%但仅58.5%完全落实，临床医生复核确认该差距。
key_points: 覆盖12类医学知识变更、1709条推荐修订
主模型识别-落实差距达32.3个百分点
14个模型均存在该分离现象
两名临床医生裁定300条回答作验证
reason: 规模较大且经临床医生裁定，但为预印本、公开性未说明，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical knowledge evolves as clinical guidelines revise recommendations, yet whether large language models (LLMs) faithfully incorporate such changes remains unclear. We introduce ChronoEvo, comprising 1,709 recommendation-level revisions across 12 forms of medical knowledge change, to distinguish recognition of revised guidance from incorporation into clinical recommendations. In the primary model, 90.8% of responses recognized revisions and 80.2% were clinically correct, but only 58.5% fully incorporated guidance, yielding a 32.3-percentage-point recognition-incorporation gap. This dissociation persisted across 14 models and was corroborated by two clinicians' adjudicated assessment of 300 responses, yielding a 40.3-percentage-point gap in the validation sample. Changes in recommendation strength and patient eligibility were associated with retention of outdated guidance. A revision-salience intervention reduced outdated-content retention and improved clinical correctness but did not significantly improve full incorporation. These findings identify faithful incorporation of evolving medical knowledge as a distinct challenge for clinical LLM reliability, even when updated guideline evidence is available.
zh_abstract: 医学知识会随着临床指南修订推荐意见而演变，但大型语言模型（LLMs）是否忠实纳入此类变化仍不清楚。我们提出ChronoEvo，包含跨越12种医学知识变化形式的1,709项推荐级别修订，用于区分对修订后指导的识别与将其纳入临床推荐。在主要模型中，90.8%的回答识别出修订，80.2%在临床上正确，但仅58.5%完全纳入指导，形成32.3个百分点的识别-纳入差距。这种分离在14个模型中持续存在，并由两名临床医生对300条回答的裁定评估所证实，在验证样本中产生40.3个百分点的差距。推荐强度和患者资格的变化与保留过时指导相关。一项修订显著性干预减少了过时内容的保留并提高了临床正确性，但未显著改善完全纳入。这些发现表明，即使有更新的指南证据可用，忠实纳入不断演变的医学知识仍是临床LLM可靠性的一个独特挑战。

title: RetiJev: Fast and Source-Grounded Ophthalmic Decision Models
zh_title: RetiJev：快速且可溯源的眼前决策模型
summary: 构建7.8万条眼科决策问答语料与2.4万题评测基准，训练0.8B–9B判别式决策模型，声称优于27B大模型与商用系统。
key_points: RetiJev-Data含78158条决策/诊断题与5万余条指南分级题
含24662题评测基准，覆盖531种眼病、11种分级体系
非自回归打分方式降低推理延迟与算力开销
reason: 预印本，含大规模语料与评测基准但未见外部临床验证，属5-6档上限
abstract: Ophthalmic clinical decision support requires fast, accurate, and privacy-preserving inference, yet autoregressive large language models (LLMs) incur substantial latency and computational overhead for decisions among predefined actions. We therefore investigate a decision-oriented alternative to generative reasoning. Specifically, we first introduce RetiJev-Data, a source-grounded ophthalmology corpus comprising 78,158 clinical-decision and diagnosis questions derived from articles in PubMed Central and a MeSH vocabulary covering 531 eye diseases, and 50,074 guideline-grading questions spanning 11 grading systems, along with a 24,662-question evaluation benchmark. Based on this, we develop RetiJev, a family of 0.8B-9B decision models that directly score candidate answers without autoregressive decoding. Across all model sizes, RetiJev outperforms both a 27B LLM and the commercial Jev 1.13 decision model on guideline grading by 10.4-23.0 points. RetiJev-9B further achieves the highest accuracy on clinical decisions, improving over both baselines by 5.4-6.5 points while matching them on diagnosis. It answers a case in 158 ms on one GPU, 3.5x faster than LLM generation and 470x faster than reasoning. Models are released at https://github.com/Awenbocc/RetiJev.
zh_abstract: 眼科临床决策支持需要快速、准确且保护隐私的推理，然而自回归大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）在预定义动作之间做决策时会产生大量延迟和计算开销。因此，我们研究一种面向决策的生成式推理替代方案。具体而言，我们首先介绍RetiJev-Data，这是一个有来源依据的眼科语料库，包含78,158个临床决策与诊断问题（源自PubMed Central中的文章）以及覆盖531种眼病的MeSH词表，还包含跨越11种分级系统的50,074个指南分级问题，以及一个24,662个问题的评估基准。基于此，我们开发了RetiJev，一系列0.8B-9B决策模型，无需自回归解码即可直接对候选答案评分。在所有模型规模上，RetiJev在指南分级方面均优于27B LLM和商业Jev 1.13决策模型10.4-23.0分。RetiJev-9B进一步在临床决策上取得最高准确率，较两个基线提高5.4-6.5分，同时在诊断上与二者相当。它在一张GPU上回答一个病例用时158 ms，比LLM生成快3.5倍，比推理快470倍。模型发布于 https://github.com/Awenbocc/RetiJev。

title: BatchBench: Benchmarking AI Robustness to Batch Effects and Domain Shift in Biomedical Images - A JUMP Cell Painting Leaderboard
zh_title: BatchBench：生物医学图像批次效应鲁棒性基准
summary: 基于JUMP-CP大规模公开细胞成像数据构建排行榜，评测AI对批次效应与域偏移的鲁棒性。
key_points: 基于Cell Painting公开图像数据，批次效应显著
以未见实验批次与数据源评测鲁棒性
以排行榜形式比较各方法性能差距
reason: 依托大规模公开数据的新基准，但为预印本且侧重评测，属值得一看档
abstract: Despite recent advances, current AI systems remain highly susceptible to domain shifts, particularly in biomedical imaging, where images are usually acquired under substantially different experimental conditions. Although recent domain adaptation methods have made substantial progress, significant performance gaps under domain shift persist. To measure progress in this regard, we introduce BatchBench, a leaderboard that evaluates and compares the robustness of AI systems on biomedical images from unseen experimental batches and data sources. BatchBench is built on JUMP-CP, one of the largest publicly available biomedical imaging datasets. Generated using the Cell Painting assay, JUMP-CP exhibits pronounced batch effects and domain shifts, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating robustness to distributional changes.
zh_abstract: 尽管近期取得了进展，当前AI系统仍极易受到域偏移影响，尤其是在生物医学成像中，图像通常在差异很大的实验条件下采集。尽管近期的域适应方法已取得实质性进展，但在域偏移下仍存在显著性能差距。为衡量这方面的进展，我们推出BatchBench，这是一个排行榜，用于评估和比较AI系统在来自未见实验批次和数据源的生物医学图像上的稳健性。BatchBench构建于JUMP-CP之上，后者是最大的公开可用生物医学成像数据集之一。JUMP-CP使用Cell Painting检测生成，表现出明显的批次效应和域偏移，使其成为评估对分布变化稳健性的具有挑战性的测试平台。

title: When Annotation Patterns Are Learned: Skin-Tone Dependence in Dermatology Concepts
zh_title: 皮肤病概念标注的肤色依赖性审计
summary: arXiv预印本审计皮肤科概念数据集SkinCon，发现同一疾病下深色皮肤的红斑标注显著少于浅色皮肤（OR=0.17），模型会复现该偏差。
key_points: 红斑在深色皮肤标注更少，OR低至0.17

abstract: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) let clinicians inspect and correct skin disease diagnoses through clinical concepts, but only if the concept annotations are reliable. We therefore audit the reliability of SkinCon, a widely used dermatology concept dataset, across skin tones. Within the same disease and with near duplicates removed, erythema is annotated far less often on dark than on light skin, with an odds ratio of 0.17. In contrast, hyperpigmentation and hypopigmentation are annotated more often, with odds ratios of 6.2 and 4.5, respectively. We refer to this pattern as tone-dependent concept annotation. An evidential concept model trained on these annotations learns the same pattern and reproduces it on unseen images. Such a model may agree with potential erythema omissions rather than contradict them. Consistent with this, three label error detectors underperform a disease-only baseline at finding erythema that dermatologist captions mention but SkinCon labels as absent. The three detectors are based on confident learning, training dynamics, and the model's own evidential uncertainty. Concept annotations should thus be audited within each subgroup before explanations built on them can be trusted.
zh_abstract: 概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）使临床医生能够通过临床概念检查和纠正皮肤病诊断，但前提是这些概念标注可靠。我们因此审核SkinCon（一个广泛使用的皮肤病学概念数据集）在不同肤色间的可靠性。在同一疾病内并去除近重复样本后，红斑在深色皮肤上的标注频率远低于浅色皮肤，比值比为0.17。相反，色素沉着过度和色素减退的标注更频繁，比值比分别为6.2和4.5。我们将此模式称为肤色依赖的概念标注。在这些标注上训练的证据概念模型学习到相同模式，并在未见图像上重现该模式。这种模型可能与潜在的红斑漏标一致，而不是对其提出反对。与此一致，在寻找皮肤科医生描述中提到但SkinCon标注为缺失的红斑方面，三种标签错误检测器的表现不如仅疾病基线。这三种检测器分别基于置信学习、训练动态和模型自身的证据不确定性。因此，在基于概念标注构建的解释能够被信任之前，应在每个亚组内审核概念标注。

title: Plausible but Unimplantable: A Trustworthiness Audit of Shape Completion Foundation Models for Cranial Defect Reconstruction

abstract: A patient who has lost part of the skull vault needs an implant that fits the defect exactly, and such implants are still drawn by hand in CAD by specialists, which makes each case slow and expensive. The task can be considered as a shape completion problem, so pretrained completion models, and now the first shape completion foundation models, look like a way to remove that manual step. We audited three publicly released pretrained shape completion models, two of them foundation models, applied zero-shot to 239 cranial defects, some carved from public skull datasets and some real post-craniectomy cases. Each output was compared with simply returning the patient's own remaining bone, and tested for whether the predicted material could be placed without intersecting the bone that is still there. On the 210 carved defects none of the three improved on doing nothing, and on the 29 real cases only one did so beyond chance. Yet not one output, from any model in any configuration, was implantable: none managed both to stay clear of the bone the patient still has and to place more material than doing nothing, where a task-specific volumetric model, trained for this task and selected on these cases, was implantable on all but one. The output that most convincingly resembles a skull is no more placeable than the rest, and at these point densities implant thickness cannot be read off the emitted points at all, which is a property of the output representation rather than of any one model. On this evidence the shape completion foundation models we could obtain cannot be trusted and, used as released, are not usable in clinical practice. Substantial research towards trustworthy foundation models for shape completion is still needed.
zh_abstract: 失去部分颅顶（skull vault）的患者需要与缺损精确贴合的植入物，而此类植入物仍由专家在计算机辅助设计（CAD）中手工绘制，这使得每个病例耗时且昂贵。该任务可视为形状补全（shape completion）问题，因此预训练补全模型，以及如今首批形状补全基础模型（foundation models），看似是消除这一手工步骤的途径。我们审计了三个公开发布的预训练形状补全模型，其中两个为基础模型，将其零样本（zero-shot）应用于 239 例颅骨缺损，其中一些是从公开颅骨数据集中切割出的缺损，一些是真实的颅骨切除术后病例。每个输出均与直接返回患者自身剩余骨组织进行比较，并检验预测材料能否在不与仍存在的骨组织相交的情况下放置。在 210 例切割缺损上，三个模型均未优于什么都不做；在 29 例真实病例上，只有一个模型以超过偶然的水平做到这一点。然而，任何模型在任何配置下的任何一个输出都不是可植入的：没有任何输出能同时做到避开患者仍有的骨组织，并且放置比什么都不做更多的材料；而一个针对该任务训练、并在这些病例上选择的特定任务体积模型（volumetric model），除一例外均可植入。最令人信服地类似颅骨的输出，其可放置性并不高于其余输出；在这些点密度下，根本无法从所输出的点中读出植入物厚度，这是输出表示（output representation）的特性，而非任何一个模型的特性。基于这一证据，我们能够获得的形状补全基础模型不可信任；按发布状态使用时，在临床实践中不可用。仍需要大量研究，以开发值得信赖的形状补全基础模型。

abstract: Automatic phenotype information extraction plays an important role in rare disease diagnosis, genotype-phenotype analysis, and precision medicine. However, accurately identifying phenotype concepts and determining their associations with specific patients remain challenging, particularly in full-text biomedical articles involving multiple patients and complex clinical descriptions. This paper presents an overview of CHIP 2026 Shared Task 1, which aims to promote the development of methods for patient-specific phenotype concept recognition from full-text biomedical literature. The task consists of two subtasks: full-text phenotype concept recognition and patient-specific phenotype association. For this evaluation, we used 200 annotated full-text biomedical articles from the PatientPheX dataset, containing 506 patients, 15,193 phenotype mentions, and 5,656 patient-phenotype associations. A total of 455 teams registered for the competition, with 189 and 103 valid submissions received on the Phase A and Phase B leaderboards, respectively. The best-performing system achieved an overall score of 0.7389 on the final test set, outperforming the baseline by 8.37 percentage points. The top-performing teams explored diverse approaches combining biomedical language models, large language models (LLMs), and ensemble strategies. The evaluation results highlight both the potential of these approaches and the remaining challenges in patient attribution and phenotype normalization from full-text biomedical literature. The post-evaluation phase remains open at https://tianchi.aliyun.com/competition/entrance/532512.
zh_abstract: 自动表型信息抽取在罕见病诊断、基因型-表型分析和精准医学中发挥重要作用。然而，准确识别表型概念并确定其与特定患者的关联仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在涉及多名患者和复杂临床描述的全文生物医学文章中。本文概述CHIP 2026共享任务1，该任务旨在促进从全文生物医学文献中进行患者特异性表型概念识别的方法开发。该任务由两个子任务组成：全文表型概念识别和患者特异性表型关联。本次评估使用PatientPheX数据集中200篇标注的全文生物医学文章，包含506名患者、15,193个表型提及和5,656个患者-表型关联。共有455支队伍注册参赛，Phase A和Phase B排行榜分别收到189份和103份有效提交。表现最佳的系统在最终测试集上取得0.7389的总分，比基线高出8.37个百分点。表现最佳的队伍探索了结合生物医学语言模型、大语言模型（LLMs）和集成策略的多种方法。评估结果既突出了这些方法的潜力，也突出了从全文生物医学文献中进行患者归因和表型标准化方面仍存在的挑战。后期评估阶段仍在https://tianchi.aliyun.com/competition/entrance/532512开放。

abstract: Early diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma is critical to preserve access to curative treatment options. The Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) provides a standardized framework for non-invasive diagnosis on multiphase computed tomography, based on major visual imaging features. However, these features may be difficult to assess consistently, particularly in small liver lesions. We developed dLI-RADS, an interpretable artificial intelligence method designed to estimate the probability of hepatocellular carcinoma from multiphase computed tomography images of manually segmented liver lesions, while remaining aligned with LI-RADS-related imaging concepts. dLI-RADS combines neural network-derived predictions with handcrafted quantitative imaging measurements reflecting LI-RADS major features and integrates these inputs using logistic regression. In this multicenter retrospective study, patients with multiphase computed tomography and at least one liver lesion were included, while lesions larger than 40 mm were excluded. Histology served as the reference standard for hepatocellular carcinoma, and a composite reference standard was used for non-hepatocellular carcinoma lesions. The lesion-level accuracy of dLI-RADS and LI-RADS were compared on the internal evaluation set using 10,000-repetition bootstrap non-inferiority tests, with 5% margins and significance levels. On the external test set, sensitivities were similarly compared. dLI-RADS was non-inferior to LI-RADS for lesion-level accuracy in the internal evaluation set, achieving 80% accuracy compared with 74% for LI-RADS (p = 0.04)...

title: Real PMIDs, Wrong Papers: Harness Design for Biomedical Claim-Verification Agents
zh_title: 生物医学论断核验智能体的框架消融研究
summary: 以PubMed为唯一工具在SciFact上对比四种智能体框架，自写查询使金标准文献召回提升约三倍。
key_points: 单次检索仅在6%论断中找到正确原文
模型自写查询使金标准召回提升约三倍

abstract: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49-59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant at our sample size and agents use fewer than half of their search budget. With gold abstracts, the same models reach 79-86% accuracy, a significant 17-24 point gap showing that retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Finally, a citation audit shows that closed-book models cite PubMed IDs that almost always exist (327/335) but are almost never relevant: a cross-family LLM judge rates only 3 of 327 existing citations as relevant to the claim, versus 67% for citations produced by the search agent. Existence checks are therefore insufficient safeguards for scientific agents. We release code, prompts, and all cached tool calls at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers.
zh_abstract: 文献检索语言智能体正成为生命科学科研助手的标准组成部分，然而关于其框架（harness）中哪些部分真正重要，尚缺乏受控证据。我们以实时 PubMed API 作为唯一工具，对生物医学论断验证（SciFact）进行了受控消融实验。在固定骨干模型和输出格式的情况下，我们比较了四种框架：闭卷作答、以论断为查询的单次检索、自行编写 PubMed 查询的 ReAct 风格智能体，以及给定金标准摘要的 oracle 设置，每种均使用两个高效前沿（efficient frontier）骨干模型。朴素的单次检索仅对 6% 的论断找到金标准论文，并将过度自信的错误转化为弃答，而未提高准确率。让模型自行制定查询使金标准召回率增至三倍，并产生最佳判定（准确率 62%，其他现实框架为 49–59%），尽管在我们的样本量下这些差异不显著，且智能体使用的搜索预算不到一半。在给定金标准摘要时，相同模型达到 79–86% 的准确率，显著的 17–24 个百分点差距表明检索而非推理是主要瓶颈。最后，引用审计显示，闭卷模型引用的 PubMed ID 几乎总是存在（327/335），但几乎从不相关：一个跨家族 LLM 评判器仅将 327 条现存引用中的 3 条评为与论断相关，而检索智能体产生的引用则为 67%。因此，存在性检查不足以为科学智能体提供保障。我们在 https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers 发布了代码、提示词及所有缓存的工具调用。

abstract: [Therapeutics and clinical risk management] Cervical cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related death among women worldwide, with a disproportionately high burden in low- and middle-income countries. Infection with human papillomavirus (HPV) is the central etiological factor. Although HPV vaccination and standardized screening can substantially reduce incidence and mortality, major bottlenecks persist in real-world settings, including inadequate coverage, loss to follow-up, data silos, and limited interpretability of algorithms. Knowledge graphs (KGs), characterized by their core "entity-relation" structure, can integrate electronic medical records, HPV genotyping, pathology/imaging, multi-omics, and public health data within a unified semantic framework, and provide traceable evidence chains and reasoning pathways to support clinical decision-making. KGs may become an important enabler. This review summarizes the potential mechanisms and application paradigms of KGs along the full continuum of cervical cancer prevention and care, including primary prevention (vaccination strategies and health education), screening and diagnosis (multimodal data integration, explainable AI, and clinical decision support systems, CDSS), as well as therapeutic decision-making and follow-up management (molecular subtyping, drug associations, and recurrence monitoring. We further highlight key challenges such as ontology standardization, cross-institutional interoperability, dynamic knowledge updating, and reliability of automated knowledge extraction. Future work should focus on establishing reusable, engineering-oriented pathways for the synergy of "KG + large language models (LLMs)/multimodal AI", the development of explainability evaluation metrics, privacy-compliant frameworks, and deployable solutions for primary care settings, in order to accelerate progress toward the global cervical cancer elimination goal.
zh_abstract: [Therapeutics and clinical risk management] 宫颈癌仍是全球女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，在低收入和中等收入国家负担不成比例地高。人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）感染是核心病因。尽管HPV疫苗接种和标准化筛查可以大幅降低发病率和死亡率，但真实世界环境中仍存在重大瓶颈，包括覆盖不足、失访、数据孤岛以及算法可解释性有限。知识图谱（KGs）以其核心“实体-关系”结构为特征，能够在统一语义框架内整合电子病历、HPV基因分型、病理/影像、多组学和公共卫生数据，并提供可追溯的证据链和推理路径以支持临床决策。知识图谱可能成为重要的赋能因素。本综述总结知识图谱在宫颈癌预防和诊疗全连续过程中的潜在机制与应用范式，包括一级预防（疫苗接种策略和健康教育）、筛查与诊断（多模态数据整合、可解释AI和临床决策支持系统，CDSS），以及治疗决策和随访管理（分子分型、药物关联和复发监测）。我们进一步强调关键挑战，如本体标准化、跨机构互操作性、动态知识更新以及自动化知识抽取的可靠性。未来工作应聚焦于建立可复用、面向工程的“知识图谱 + 大语言模型（LLMs）/多模态AI”协同路径，开发可解释性评价指标、符合隐私要求的框架，以及可在基层医疗环境中部署的解决方案，以加速实现全球消除宫颈癌目标。

abstract: [Mayo Clinic proceedings] To assess the correlation between the Dermoscopy Explainable Intelligence (DEXI) score and histopathologically confirmed melanoma and non-melanoma skin cancer in a cohort of patients. This retrospective review included 178 patients who underwent total body photography by the Vectra WB360 system (Canfield Scientific Inc), sequential digital dermoscopy imaging, and subsequent biopsy of 1 or more skin lesions between May 1, 2023, and August 30, 2024. By use of an artificial intelligence-generated scoring system trained on more than 66,000 annotated dermoscopy images known as DEXI, the dermoscopy images were assigned a score from 0.0 to 10.0 calculated to assist in malignancy assessment. The histopathologically confirmed diagnosis of biopsied lesions was then compared with its associated DEXI score. Average DEXI scores by diagnosis were determined, and a clinically appropriate cut point for DEXI score was calculated. Of the 261 cases, 160 were benign with an average corresponding DEXI score of 2.5, 65 cases were non-melanoma skin cancer with an average DEXI score of 7.8, and 14 cases were melanoma with an average DEXI score of 6.0. DEXI scores from malignant lesions were statistically significantly higher than those from benign lesions. Using 3.0 as a cut point for DEXI score, we observed a sensitivity of 93.7% and a specificity of 75% in differentiating benign from malignant disease. The DEXI score was overall effective at differentiating benign from malignant disease. Larger prospective multicenter validation will be required to further evaluate for clinical use.
zh_abstract: [Mayo Clinic proceedings] 评估在一组患者中，皮肤镜可解释智能（Dermoscopy Explainable Intelligence, DEXI）评分与组织病理学确诊的黑色素瘤及非黑色素瘤皮肤癌之间的相关性。这项回顾性综述纳入178名患者，这些患者在2023年5月1日至2024年8月30日期间接受了Vectra WB360系统（Canfield Scientific Inc）全身摄影、连续数字皮肤镜成像，并随后对1个或多个皮肤病灶进行了活检。使用一种基于超过66,000张标注皮肤镜图像训练的人工智能生成评分系统（称为DEXI），为皮肤镜图像赋予0.0至10.0的评分，该评分旨在辅助恶性度评估。随后将活检病灶的组织病理学确诊诊断与其相关DEXI评分进行比较。按诊断确定平均DEXI评分，并计算DEXI评分的临床适当截断点。在261例病例中，160例为良性，平均相应DEXI评分为2.5；65例为非黑色素瘤皮肤癌，平均DEXI评分为7.8；14例为黑色素瘤，平均DEXI评分为6.0。恶性病灶的DEXI评分在统计学上显著高于良性病灶。以3.0作为DEXI评分截断点，我们观察到区分良性与恶性疾病的敏感性为93.7%，特异性为75%。DEXI评分总体上能有效区分良性与恶性疾病。需要更大规模的前瞻性多中心验证来进一步评估其临床用途。

abstract: [Journal of esthetic and restorative dentistry : official publication of the American Academy of Esthetic Dentistry ... [et al.]] To evaluate the clinical accuracy, usefulness, global overall quality (GQS), and readability of ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek responses to patient questions regarding dental caries. Fifty-nine simulated patient questions concerning caries diagnosis, etiology, treatment, and prevention were queried in Turkish. Three restorative dentists independently evaluated the responses for accuracy, usefulness, and GQS. Readability was assessed using the Ateşman index. Statistical analyses included the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) for interrater reliability, the Friedman test for performance comparisons among the models, and Spearman's rank correlation to analyze the relationships between the clinical variables. Inter-rater reliability was high across all criteria (ICC > 0.75). Significant performance differences existed among the models (p < 0.001); Gemini achieved the highest overall clinical accuracy, usefulness, and GQS scores. ChatGPT produced the most readable texts, categorized generally as "easy to read" according to the Ateşman index. For DeepSeek, higher clinical accuracy significantly correlated with better readability (p < 0.001). Gemini offers the highest accuracy and quality as a digital preconsultation tool. However, AI tools should complement, not replace, professional dental advice.

[et al.]] 评估ChatGPT、Gemini和DeepSeek对患者关于龋齿问题的回答的临床准确性、有用性、全局总体质量（GQS）和可读性。以土耳其语查询了59个关于龋齿诊断、病因、治疗和预防的模拟患者问题。三名修复牙科医生独立评估回答的准确性、有用性和GQS。可读性采用Ateşman指数评估。统计分析包括用于评估评分者间信度的组内相关系数（ICC）、用于比较各模型表现的Friedman检验，以及用于分析临床变量之间关系的Spearman秩相关。所有标准的评分者间信度均较高（ICC > 0.75）。各模型之间存在显著表现差异（p < 0.001）；Gemini获得最高的总体临床准确性、有用性和GQS评分。ChatGPT生成的文本最易读，根据Ateşman指数通常归类为“容易阅读”。对于DeepSeek，较高的临床准确性与更好的可读性显著相关（p < 0.001）。作为数字化预咨询工具，Gemini提供最高的准确性和质量。然而，AI工具应补充而非替代专业牙科建议。

abstract: [Oral and maxillofacial surgery clinics of North America] Head and neck reconstruction is a technically demanding subspecialty where successful outcomes require precise restoration of facial form alongside masticatory and speech function. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning algorithms offer potential to expedite clinical workflows, flatten the surgical learning curve for head and neck surgeons, and enhance risk stratification of surgical patients. This article outlines the role of AI in automated image segmentation for preoperative virtual surgical planning and intraoperative guidance for perforator identification, assessment of skin paddle viability, and microvascular anastomosis safety. Applications in perioperative optimization and postoperative care of high-risk surgical patients are discussed.

abstract: [International journal of dermatology] Residents increasingly ask large language models to name a lesion before diagnosing it themselves. The practice contributes a specific harm: never-skilling, a phenomenon in which reasoning is never acquired, and is distinct from 'deskilling' or 'model error'. Forming a differential first is necessary but insufficient. Departments should require documented differentials, supervise disagreement, and examine unassisted reasoning.

title: Dynamic control of carbon-ion radiation dose distribution amid respiratory motion challenges: A review of prediction research using geant4 and deep learning physics-constrained models.
source: PubMed · Journal of applied clinical medical physics
zh_title: 呼吸运动下碳离子放疗剂量动态控制：Geant4 与深度学习综述
summary: 综述汇总运动分辨成像、动态剂量预测、4D 鲁棒计划与自适应方法，重点讨论 Geant4 蒙特卡洛结合物理约束深度学习模型。
key_points: 呼吸运动导致剂量不确定性与交互效应
涵盖物理信息神经网络等深度学习剂量预测
涉及临床治疗计划系统与放射生物学建模

abstract: [Journal of applied clinical medical physics] Carbon ion radiotherapy (CIRT) offers superior dose conformity and biological effectiveness; however, its precision is highly sensitive to respiratory motion, leading to dose uncertainty and interplay effects that compromise treatment accuracy. A comprehensive literature synthesis was conducted on studies employing motion-resolved imaging techniques (e.g. SMEIR), dynamic dose prediction, 4D robust planning, and hybrid adaptive methods for CIRT. The study emphasised the use of Geant4 Monte Carlo simulations combined with deep learning models, including physics-informed neural networks, to simulate and predict dose perturbations caused by respiratory motion. This review also examined clinical treatment planning systems, radiobiological modelling, and adaptive strategies to mitigate the effects of motion. The integration of Geant4 with deep learning enabled high-fidelity, computationally efficient dose prediction under respiratory motion, improving accuracy in dose localization and adaptation. Motion management techniques such as respiratory gating, rescanning, and 4D robust optimization demonstrated enhanced tumor control and normal tissue sparing. Hybrid models combining Monte Carlo data and AI inference show promise for near-real-time adaptive therapy. Despite these advances, challenges remain, including limited motion-rich datasets, computational demands for real-time recalculations, and the complexity of incorporating variable relative biological effectiveness (RBE) into adaptive planning. Combining Geant4-based Monte Carlo simulations with deep learning frameworks shows emerging promise for controlling carbon ion dose distributions amid respiratory motion, though direct clinical validation for this combination remains limited. These hybrid models may enhance the precision and adaptability of CIRT, offering improved outcomes. Future efforts should focus on clinical validation, standardization, and overcoming computational and data limitations to facilitate clinical translation of motion-adaptive CIRT. These approaches remain at Technology Readiness Levels (TRL 3-5) and require prospective clinical validation before routine implementation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of applied clinical medical physics] 碳离子放疗（carbon ion radiotherapy, CIRT）具有更优的剂量适形性和生物学效应；然而，其精度对呼吸运动高度敏感，导致剂量不确定性和 interplay 效应，从而损害治疗准确性。本文对采用运动分辨成像技术（如 SMEIR）、动态剂量预测、4D 稳健规划以及混合自适应方法进行 CIRT 的研究进行了综合性文献分析。该研究强调使用 Geant4 Monte Carlo 模拟结合深度学习模型（包括物理信息神经网络）来模拟和预测呼吸运动引起的剂量扰动。本综述还考察了临床治疗计划系统、放射生物学建模以及减轻运动影响的自适应策略。将 Geant4 与深度学习相结合，可在呼吸运动下实现高保真、计算高效的剂量预测，提高剂量定位和自适应中的准确性。呼吸门控、重扫描和 4D 稳健优化等运动管理技术显示出改善的肿瘤控制和正常组织保护。结合 Monte Carlo 数据和 AI 推理的混合模型在近实时自适应治疗方面显示出前景。尽管取得了这些进展，挑战仍然存在，包括缺乏富含运动的数据集、实时重计算的计算需求，以及将可变的相对生物学效应（relative biological effectiveness, RBE）纳入自适应规划的复杂性。将基于 Geant4 的 Monte Carlo 模拟与深度学习框架相结合，在控制呼吸运动中的碳离子剂量分布方面显示出新兴前景，尽管该组合的直接临床验证仍然有限。这些混合模型可能提高 CIRT 的精确性和适应性，从而改善结局。未来的工作应侧重于临床验证、标准化以及克服计算和数据限制，以促进运动自适应 CIRT 的临床转化。这些方法仍处于技术成熟度（Technology Readiness Levels, TRL）3-5 级，在常规实施前需要前瞻性临床验证。

title: Explainable Multimodal AI for In-Hospital Detection of Lung Cancer and Heart Failure Using Routine Data: Development, Internal Validation, and Simulated Federated Evaluation

检验解释忠实性并按人群审计公平性

reason: 大样本但仅内部验证且联邦为模拟，未达外部验证档
abstract: Objective: To determine whether combining four routine data sources improves in-hospital detection of lung cancer and heart failure, which sources drive each prediction, whether explanations are faithful, whether models are fair, and how much benefit federated training retains. Methods: In this retrospective single-centre study, we linked MIMIC-IV admissions (73,637 patients) to chest radiographs, radiology reports, 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) and laboratory tests from the first 48 hours. For each disease, excluding prior cases, we compared single-source models, gradient boosting and early, late and attention-based fusion on patient-level splits. We tested explanations for faithfulness and weight dependence, audited performance by sex, age, race and ethnicity, and insurance, and simulated five unequal hospitals to compare federated, centralised and local training. Results: Lung cancer was coded in 1.7% and heart failure in 15.6% of patients. For lung cancer, attention fusion reached an area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of 0.833 (95% CI 0.809-0.859) against 0.753 for gradient boosting on laboratory data; for heart failure, 0.885 (0.878-0.892) against 0.794 (both p < 0.001). Early and late fusion performed similarly. Laboratory data and radiology reports contributed most to lung cancer, and the ECG to heart failure. Explanations passed a deletion test; a weight-randomisation check on absolute attributions passed for ECG but not for laboratory explanations. For heart failure, discrimination fell with age. Federated training recovered 95% of the centralised gain over local training for heart failure; for lung cancer, federated averaging (FedAvg) recovered 51% and FedProx 82%. Conclusion: Fusing routine data improved in-hospital detection of both diseases over laboratory data alone, and which data matter depends on the disease. Explanation checks should be run per source and per similarity measure, and performance in older patients monitored. For the rare outcome, FedProx, which limits drift between sites, retained more of the pooled benefit than FedAvg. External validation is needed.
zh_abstract: 【目的】确定结合四种常规数据源是否能改善肺癌和心力衰竭的院内检测、哪些数据源驱动每项预测、解释是否忠实、模型是否公平，以及联邦训练能保留多少获益。【方法】在这项回顾性单中心研究中，我们将MIMIC-IV入院记录（73,637名患者）与胸部X线片、放射学报告、12导联心电图（ECG）和最初48小时内的实验室检查相链接。对于每种疾病，排除既往病例后，我们在患者水平划分上比较了单源模型、梯度提升以及早期、晚期和基于注意力的融合。我们检验了解释的忠实性和权重依赖性，按性别、年龄、种族和族裔以及保险审计了性能，并模拟五家规模不等的医院以比较联邦、集中式和本地训练。【结果】肺癌在1.7%的患者中被编码，心力衰竭在15.6%的患者中被编码。对于肺癌，注意力融合达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.833（95% CI 0.809-0.859），而基于实验室数据的梯度提升为0.753；对于心力衰竭，分别为0.885（0.878-0.892）和0.794（两者p < 0.001）。早期和晚期融合表现相似。实验室数据和放射学报告对肺癌贡献最大，而ECG对心力衰竭贡献最大。解释通过了删除测试；对绝对归因的权重随机化检查在ECG上通过，但在实验室检查解释上未通过。对于心力衰竭，区分度随年龄下降。对于心力衰竭，联邦训练保留了集中式训练相对于本地训练所得增益的95%；对于肺癌，联邦平均（FedAvg）保留了51%，FedProx保留了82%。【结论】融合常规数据较仅使用实验室数据改善了两种疾病的院内检测，而哪些数据重要取决于疾病。解释检查应按数据源和相似性度量分别进行，并监测老年患者中的性能。对于罕见结局，限制站点间漂移的FedProx比FedAvg保留了更多汇总获益。仍需外部验证。

title: UnibindMD: An Integrated AI and Molecular Dynamics Platform for De Novo Peptide Binder Design
zh_title: UnibindMD：AI与分子动力学整合的从头肽结合剂设计平台
summary: 预印本发布整合平台，串联BindCraft设计、结构预测、亲和力预测、成药性评估与全原子分子动力学验证。
key_points: 五阶段串联：设计、结构预测、亲和力、成药性、分子动力学
针对ipTM、pLDDT等置信度指标自洽但不独立的问题
在三种安第斯病毒干预靶点上做演示
reason: 有新意的预印本计算平台，仅有演示性案例、无实验验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: UnibindMD is an integrated computational platform that turns a protein target into validated de novo peptide-binder leads by chaining five orthogonal stages: deep-learning binder design (BindCraft), independent structure prediction and confidence assessment (AlphaFold3-class / Boltz-2), binding-affinity prediction (PRODIGY), developability profiling (ADMET-AI), and all-atom molecular-dynamics validation (GROMACS/CHARMM36m). The platform targets a persistent weakness of single-method design, namely that confidence metrics such as ipTM and pLDDT are self-consistent but not independent, so a design predicted to be confident may still be physically unstable. We demonstrate UnibindMD on three Andes virus (ANDV) intervention points, a setting of urgent need given a case fatality rate approaching 40%, a 2026 MV Hondius cruise-ship outbreak (13 cases, 3 deaths), and no approved therapeutic: the Gn-Gc glycoprotein complex (viral entry), the L-protein endonuclease domain (cap-snatching; PDB 6Q99), and the host VEGFR2 kinase (vascular permeability; PDB 2XIR). Across nine BindCraft campaigns (4,475 trajectories) the platform produced 464 accepted binders (acceptance 2.3-67.6%), with top candidates reaching ipTM = 0.94 and pLDDT = 0.94. The three selected leads were predicted by PRODIGY to bind with G = -9.1 to -11.1 kcal mol-1 (Kd 8 nM-0.2 M), and all three remained stably bound over 100 ns of unrestrained molecular dynamics (receptor CRMSD [≤] 2.6 [A], retained peptide fold, [≥] 99.5% of frames preserving more than half of the initial interface contacts, and 75-82% helical content). ADMET-AI flagged the expected poor oral bioavailability of large polar peptides and no PAINS alerts. By converting single-prediction design into a cross-validated, dynamics-tested workflow, UnibindMD provides a rapid, scalable, and generalizable path from any protein target to validated peptide-binder candidates.
zh_abstract: UnibindMD 是一个集成计算平台，通过串联五个正交阶段，将蛋白质靶点转化为经验证的从头肽结合物先导物：深度学习结合物设计（BindCraft）、独立结构预测与置信度评估（AlphaFold3 类 / Boltz-2）、结合亲和力预测（PRODIGY）、可开发性分析（ADMET-AI）以及全原子分子动力学验证（GROMACS/CHARMM36m）。该平台针对单方法设计的一个长期弱点，即 ipTM 和 pLDDT 等置信度指标自洽但不独立，因此一个被预测为高置信度的设计仍可能在物理上不稳定。我们在三个安第斯病毒（Andes virus, ANDV）干预靶点上展示 UnibindMD；鉴于病死率接近 40%、2026 年 MV Hondius 邮轮暴发（13 例，3 例死亡）且尚无获批疗法，这一场景具有迫切需求：Gn-Gc 糖蛋白复合物（病毒进入）、L 蛋白核酸内切酶结构域（cap-snatching；PDB 6Q99）和宿主 VEGFR2 激酶（血管通透性；PDB 2XIR）。在九轮 BindCraft 活动中（4,475 条轨迹），平台产生了 464 个被接受的结合物（接受率 2.3–67.6%），最佳候选达到 ipTM = 0.94 和 pLDDT = 0.94。三个选定先导物经 PRODIGY 预测以 G = -9.1 至 -11.1 kcal mol-1 结合（Kd 8 nM–0.2 M），且三者均在 100 ns 无约束分子动力学中保持稳定结合（受体 CRMSD ≤ 2.6 Å，肽折叠得以保留，≥ 99.5% 的帧保留超过一半的初始界面接触，以及 75–82% 的螺旋含量）。ADMET-AI 标记出大分子极性肽预期的口服生物利用度差，且未出现 PAINS 警报。通过将单次预测设计转化为交叉验证、经过动力学测试的工作流程，UnibindMD 提供了从任何蛋白质靶点到经验证的肽结合物候选物的快速、可扩展且可推广的路径。
