abstract: Accurate hippocampal segmentation can be a useful tool for diagnosing and monitoring neurological conditions such as Alzheimer's disease and epilepsy. While numerous automated segmentation methods exist, their clinical adoption remains limited. Reliable uncertainty assessment can enhance trust and facilitate clinical translation. This study evaluates ensembles of five heterogeneous hippocampal segmentation methods - InnerEye, ASHS, FastSurfer, HippoSeg, and FreeSurfer - across two dementia datasets and one epilepsy dataset. The sub-ensemble containing InnerEye, FastSurfer, and HippoSeg emerged as both accurate and efficient, highlighting the feasibility of balancing computational cost and performance. Additionally, ensemble-derived uncertainty quantification with sample variance, mutual information, and predictive entropy is shown to reduce inaccurate segmentations by flagging low-confidence cases, potentially providing a mechanism for automatically escalating ambiguous cases for expert assessment. Lastly, this study explores the downstream clinical utility of ensemble-derived uncertainty, finding a significant correlation with motion artefact severity and a modest contribution to Alzheimer's disease classification.
zh_abstract: 准确的海马分割可以成为诊断和监测阿尔茨海默病和癫痫等神经系统疾病的有用工具。尽管存在众多自动分割方法，但其临床采用仍然有限。可靠的不确定性评估可以增强信任并促进临床转化。本研究在两个痴呆数据集和一个癫痫数据集上评估由五种异质性海马分割方法——InnerEye、ASHS、FastSurfer、HippoSeg 和 FreeSurfer——构成的集成。包含 InnerEye、FastSurfer 和 HippoSeg 的子集成表现出既准确又高效，突显了平衡计算成本和性能的可行性。此外，使用样本方差、互信息和预测熵的集成衍生不确定性量化被证明能够通过标记低置信度病例来减少不准确的分割，可能提供一种自动将模糊病例升级以供专家评估的机制。最后，本研究探讨集成衍生不确定性的下游临床效用，发现其与运动伪影严重程度显著相关，并对阿尔茨海默病分类有适度贡献。

title: From validation to public health impact: implementing equitable AI-enabled diabetic retinopathy screening.
zh_title: 从验证到公共卫生影响：公平的AI糖网筛查
summary: 综述性文章重新审视AI糖尿病视网膜病变筛查，指出诊断准确率不等于人群健康收益，需关注可及性、转诊与治疗能力。
key_points: AI视网膜筛查已从前瞻研究走向真实世界部署
仅靠诊断准确率不足以保证公共卫生收益
漏筛、图像不可判读、转诊不全与数字壁垒会削弱效果
reason: 综述类封顶6档，聚焦落地与公平的框架性讨论，无新数据
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a preventable cause of vision loss as diabetes prevalence rises worldwide. Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled retinal screening has progressed from retrospective validation to prospective and real-world deployment, with recent reviews showing high diagnostic performance across fundus photography, smartphone-based systems, and autonomous platforms. Yet diagnostic accuracy alone does not ensure public health benefit. Population impact can be lost when eligible people are not reached, images are ungradable, results are delayed, referrals are incomplete, treatment capacity is insufficient, or disadvantaged groups face financial, geographic, or digital barriers. Unlike reviews centered mainly on diagnostic accuracy or economic performance, this Mini Review reframes AI-enabled DR screening as a population-health intervention spanning detection through completion of effective eye care. We synthesize evidence on diagnostic validity, implementation, economics, referral completion, care cascades, patient-centered outcomes, equity, and governance. We argue that effectiveness and cost-effectiveness are properties of the complete screening-to-treatment pathway, not the algorithm alone, and propose a four-domain framework encompassing technical validity, service integration, population impact, and equity and sustainability. Future research should prioritize comparative implementation studies and outcome sets that capture screening reach, gradability, referral completion, treatment initiation, time to treatment, avoidable vision loss, vision-related quality of life, acceptability, costs, and subgroup equity. The policy question is no longer whether AI can detect DR, but whether health systems can translate automated detection into equitable completion of effective eye care at scale.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Public Health] 随着全球糖尿病患病率上升，糖尿病视网膜病变（diabetic retinopathy, DR）仍是一种可预防的视力丧失原因。人工智能（AI）赋能的视网膜筛查已从回顾性验证进展到前瞻性和真实世界部署，近期综述显示其在眼底摄影、基于智能手机的系统和自主平台中具有较高诊断性能。然而，仅凭诊断准确性并不能确保公共卫生获益。当无法覆盖符合条件的人群、图像不可分级、结果延迟、转诊不完整、治疗能力不足，或弱势群体面临经济、地理或数字障碍时，人群影响可能丧失。与主要关注诊断准确性或经济表现的综述不同，本小型综述（Mini Review）将AI赋能的DR筛查重新界定为一项贯穿从检出到完成有效眼科照护的人群健康干预。我们综合了关于诊断有效性、实施、经济学、转诊完成、照护级联、以患者为中心的结局、公平性和治理的证据。我们认为，有效性和成本-效果是整个筛查至治疗路径的属性，而非仅算法本身的属性，并提出一个涵盖技术有效性、服务整合、人群影响以及公平性与可持续性的四领域框架。未来研究应优先开展比较性实施研究和结局指标集，以捕捉筛查覆盖范围、图像可分级性、转诊完成、治疗启动、至治疗时间、可避免的视力丧失、视觉相关生活质量、可接受性、成本以及亚组公平性。政策问题不再是AI能否检出DR，而是卫生系统能否将自动检出大规模转化为公平完成有效眼科照护。

title: Visualizing and Interpreting Temporal Care Team Dynamics for Cancer Survival Risk Analysis
zh_title: 肿瘤医疗团队协作时序动态与生存风险可视化
summary: 基于电子病历沟通数据构建动态协作网络，用时序图神经网络估计肿瘤患者结局风险并做可视分析。
key_points: 由EHR沟通数据构建动态协作网络
用时序图神经网络估计随时间变化的风险
分析团队构成变化与风险变化的关联
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，缺乏外部验证与临床结局评估
abstract: Cancer care is a longitudinal, time-sensitive process requiring coordination among diverse healthcare professionals (HCPs), whose collaboration evolves throughout treatment. Prior studies link care team structure to patient outcomes, but the temporal dynamics of collaboration and their relationship to evolving patient risk remain poorly understood. We introduce a visual analytics framework for modeling and interpreting time-varying care team interactions in oncology. We construct dynamic collaboration networks from electronic health record (EHR)-mediated communication data and use a temporal graph neural network (TGNN) to estimate patient outcome risk over time. We then investigate how changes in care team composition and specialist participation relate to shifts in estimated risk across treatment stages. Our multi-view interactive system combines TGNN-based risk modeling with coordinated visualizations of care team networks, feature-level explanations from a surrogate logistic regression model, and exploratory what-if analysis. Without making causal claims, the system helps analysts examine how risk estimates co-evolve with collaboration patterns and identify care team characteristics associated with these changes. We demonstrate its utility through expert-guided analysis scenarios involving 505 patients with breast, colorectal, and lung cancers, evaluating its ability to reveal clinically meaningful collaboration patterns. This work improves the interpretability of temporal graph-based models in longitudinal, team-based healthcare, with potential applicability to other evolving collaborative settings.
zh_abstract: 癌症照护是一个纵向、时间敏感的过程，需要不同医疗专业人员（HCP）之间的协调，其协作在整个治疗过程中不断演变。既往研究将照护团队结构与患者结局联系起来，但协作的时间动态及其与患者风险演变的关系仍知之甚少。我们提出一个可视化分析框架，用于建模和解释肿瘤学中随时间变化的照护团队互动。我们从电子健康记录（EHR）介导的通信数据构建动态协作网络，并使用时间图神经网络（TGNN）估计患者随时间变化的结局风险。然后，我们研究照护团队构成和专科医生参与的变化如何与不同治疗阶段估计风险的转变相关。我们的多视图交互系统将基于 TGNN 的风险建模与照护团队网络的协调可视化、来自替代逻辑回归模型的特征级解释以及探索性假设分析（what-if analysis）相结合。该系统不作因果断言，帮助分析人员检查风险估计如何与协作模式共同演变，并识别与这些变化相关的照护团队特征。我们通过涉及 505 名乳腺癌、结直肠癌和肺癌患者的专家引导分析场景展示其效用，评估其揭示具有临床意义的协作模式的能力。这项工作提高了时间图模型在纵向、团队式医疗照护中的可解释性，并可能适用于其他不断演变的协作场景。

title: EG-BINN: Parameter-Efficient Ensembling of Gated Biologically Informed Neural Networks for Epigenetic Age Estimation
zh_title: EG-BINN：参数高效的表观遗传年龄估计模型
summary: 提出门控生物学信息神经网络的参数高效集成模型，在93个多组织数据集训练并在8个留出数据集评估。
key_points: 以样本特异门控调制生物学节点表征
在8个留出GEO数据集误差低于基线
分析门控机制与生物学注释的关联
reason: 预印本方法有留出数据集对比但缺独立临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Epigenetic aging clocks are widely used to evaluate biological aging, disease risk, and clinical interventions. However, most existing clocks rely on linear models that overlook nonlinear relationships between age and methylation patterns, or on deep learning architectures that are parameter-intensive and difficult to interpret. We developed EG-BINN, a parameter-efficient ensemble of biologically informed neural networks that uses sample-specific gating to modulate representations across biologically annotated nodes. Trained on 93 multi-tissue datasets, EG-BINN achieved the lowest mean and median absolute errors among matched linear and nonlinear baselines in five-fold cross-validation, as well as the lowest mean absolute and root mean squared errors across eight held-out Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) datasets. Analysis of the gating mechanism revealed widespread associations between pathway gate values and age, including trajectories that varied across blood, adipose tissue, skeletal muscle, and liver. Across 11 TCGA cohorts, EG-BINN identified significant tumor--normal differences in residual epigenetic age acceleration in six cohorts, whereas Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) highlighted recurrent pathway nodes contributing to tumor age predictions. EG-BINN combines accurate pan-tissue age prediction with an explainable architecture for examining biologically labeled nodes across age, tissue, and disease contexts.
zh_abstract: 表观遗传衰老时钟被广泛用于评估生物学衰老、疾病风险和临床干预。然而，大多数现有时钟依赖线性模型，忽略了年龄与甲基化模式之间的非线性关系，或依赖参数密集且难以解释的深度学习架构。我们开发了EG-BINN，这是一种参数高效的生物信息引导神经网络集成，使用样本特异性门控在具有生物学注释的节点上调节表示。EG-BINN在93个多组织数据集上训练，在五折交叉验证中于匹配的线性和非线性基线中取得了最低的平均绝对误差和中位绝对误差，并在八个保留的Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）数据集上取得了最低的平均绝对误差和均方根误差。对门控机制的分析揭示了通路门控值与年龄之间的广泛关联，包括在血液、脂肪组织、骨骼肌和肝脏中表现不同的轨迹。在11个TCGA队列中，EG-BINN在六个队列中识别出残差表观遗传年龄加速的显著肿瘤-正常差异，而Shapley加性解释（SHAP）突出了对肿瘤年龄预测有贡献的反复出现的通路节点。EG-BINN将准确的泛组织年龄预测与可解释架构相结合，用于在年龄、组织和疾病背景下检查具有生物学标签的节点。

title: An Interpretable Machine Learning Framework for Early- versus Late-Stage Classification of Breast Cancer from Gene Expression, with Co-expression Network Analysis
zh_title: 基因表达区分乳腺癌早晚期及共表达网络分析
summary: 基于TCGA乳腺癌1,075例RNA-seq，用65个基因面板与可解释机器学习区分早晚期。
key_points: TCGA-BRCA共分析1,075例原发肿瘤
训练860例、留出测试215例
比较逻辑回归、SVM、随机森林与梯度提升
reason: 预印本回顾性研究，仅数据集内划分，无外部验证
abstract: Anatomical stage is a principal determinant of treatment and prognosis in breast cancer, yet it is unclear how much information about stage is carried by the transcriptome of the primary tumour. We asked whether an a priori panel of 65 cancer-related genes can distinguish early-stage (AJCC Stage I-II) from late-stage (Stage III-IV) breast cancer, and which genes contribute to any signal. RNA-seq expression and pathologic stage for The Cancer Genome Atlas breast invasive carcinoma cohort (TCGA-BRCA) were obtained from the UCSC Xena platform. After restricting the data to primary tumours with a known stage, 1,075 tumours were analysed (805 early, 270 late) and split into stratified training (n = 860) and held-out test (n = 215) sets. Logistic regression, a support vector machine, random forest and gradient boosting were tuned by stratified five-fold cross-validation, with median imputation, standardisation and SMOTE oversampling fitted on training data only and classification thresholds chosen on out-of-fold training predictions. On the test set, Logistic Regression had the highest ROC-AUC, 0.618 (95% CI 0.530-0.704), with balanced accuracy 0.578, sensitivity 0.741 and specificity 0.416; differences in AUC between models were not statistically significant (DeLong p = 0.199-0.585). Permutation importance in the Gradient Boosting model ranked POU5F1, FLT3 and NOTCH1 highest, but this model's AUC confidence interval included 0.5, so the ranking is exploratory. No gene was differentially expressed between stage groups after false-discovery-rate (FDR) correction (smallest FDR = 0.057, CD44). A co-expression network built from training tumours identified REL, EP300 and ESR1 as the most connected genes, a property that reflects co-expression rather than regulation or association with stage. Limitations include a single cohort, no external validation, no clinical covariates and a small number of late-stage test tumours. Expression of this gene panel carries limited but measurable information about anatomical stage; expression-based stage models should be combined with clinicopathological variables and validated in independent cohorts before any clinical application is considered.
zh_abstract: 解剖学分期是乳腺癌治疗和预后的主要决定因素，但原发肿瘤转录组携带多少分期信息仍不清楚。我们询问一个由65个癌症相关基因组成的先验基因组合能否区分早期（AJCC I-II期）与晚期（III-IV期）乳腺癌，以及哪些基因对任何信号有贡献。癌症基因组图谱乳腺浸润性癌队列（TCGA-BRCA）的RNA测序（RNA-seq）表达数据和病理分期数据取自UCSC Xena平台。将数据限定为具有已知分期的原发肿瘤后，共分析1,075个肿瘤（805个早期，270个晚期），并按分层拆分为训练集（n = 860）和留出测试集（n = 215）。逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）、支持向量机、随机森林和梯度提升通过分层五折交叉验证进行调参，其中中位数插补、标准化和SMOTE过采样仅在训练数据上拟合，分类阈值根据折外训练预测选择。在测试集上，逻辑回归的ROC-AUC最高，为0.618（95% CI 0.530-0.704），平衡准确率为0.578，灵敏度为0.741，特异度为0.416；模型间AUC差异无统计学意义（DeLong p = 0.199-0.585）。梯度提升模型中的置换重要性将POU5F1、FLT3和NOTCH1排在最前，但该模型的AUC置信区间包含0.5，因此该排序是探索性的。经错误发现率（FDR）校正后，分期组间无基因差异表达（最小FDR = 0.057，CD44）。基于训练肿瘤构建的共表达网络识别出REL、EP300和ESR1为连接度最高的基因，这一属性反映的是共表达，而非调控作用或与分期的关联。局限性包括单队列、无外部验证、无临床协变量以及晚期测试肿瘤数量少。该基因组合的表达携带有限但可测量的解剖学分期信息；基于表达的分期模型应与临床病理变量结合，并在考虑任何临床应用之前于独立队列中验证。

title: From Structured Records to Patient Narratives: Preserving Clinical Alignment in LLM-Generated Health Summaries
zh_title: LLM健康摘要的临床对齐与语义漂移
summary: 研究用结构化证据约束与RAG生成月经健康摘要，评估3个LLM共4500条输出的语义对齐与可读性。
key_points: 以NLI与原子事实性指标评估语义对齐
结合结构化证据条件与RAG约束生成
覆盖3个LLM、4500条生成摘要
reason: 预印本方法研究，有基线对比但无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: As wearable and digital health systems increasingly generate longitudinal physiological records, communicating these observations in patient-accessible language remains a significant challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising mechanism for translating structured clinical information into readable narratives, but this process may introduce semantic drift, where clinically precise meaning is distorted during simplification. We investigate evidence-grounded health summarization for menstrual health monitoring using a constrained generation framework that combines structured evidence conditioning with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using a prompt-based constrained generation framework. We evaluate semantic alignment using Natural Language Inference (NLI), atomic factuality metrics, and readability measures. Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent. We also find that improved clinical alignment comes at the cost of increased reading difficulty and medical terminology. These findings highlight the need to jointly evaluate faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, and readability when developing patient-facing medical LLM systems.
zh_abstract: 随着可穿戴和数字健康系统日益产生纵向生理记录，以患者可理解的语言传达这些观察结果仍是一项重大挑战。大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLM）提供了一种有前景的机制，可将结构化临床信息转化为可读叙述，但该过程可能引入语义漂移，即在简化过程中扭曲临床精确含义。我们采用一个受约束的生成框架，研究用于月经健康监测的循证健康摘要，该框架将结构化证据条件与使用基于提示的受约束生成框架的检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）相结合。我们使用自然语言推理（Natural Language Inference, NLI）、原子事实性指标和可读性指标评估语义对齐。在三个 LLM 和 4,500 份生成摘要中，显式证据接地约束持续改善临床对齐，尤其是通过改善不确定性保留；并且，在根据检索证据评估忠实性时，通常保持或改善忠实性，而对遗漏的影响仍取决于模型。我们还发现，临床对齐的改善以阅读难度增加和医学术语增多为代价。这些发现凸显了在开发面向患者的医学 LLM 系统时，需要联合评估忠实性、不确定性保留和可读性。

title: IndoNutriQA: An Indonesian Clinical Nutrition Question Answering Benchmark
zh_title: IndoNutriQA：印尼语临床营养问答基准
summary: 发布911组专家整理的印尼语临床营养问答对，按营养照护流程设8类标准化问题。
key_points: 911组问答源自真实临床营养报告
8类问题遵循营养照护流程NCP
附人体测量、诊断与来源分段等元数据
reason: 低资源语种专家标注评测基准，规模中等，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical Question Answering (QA) underpins Clinical Intelligent Decision Support Systems, but progress is severely limited for low-resource languages such as Indonesian by the absence of public domain-specific data. We introduce IndoNutriQA, an expert-curated Indonesian clinical QA benchmark of 911 question-answer pairs built from real clinical-nutrition reports. Rather than a large-scale training corpus, it is positioned as a high-quality evaluation resource: every pair is grounded in a clinically relevant context, enriched with structured metadata (anthropometric assessment, medical diagnosis, document provenance, chunk segmentation). Eight standardised question types following the Nutrition Care Process (NCP), including the Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom (PES) diagnosis statement, are answered for every report, which was written by a graduate-level dietetic intern, by one of three nutritionists. Answers are free-form clinical prose rather than extractive spans, and an expert validation study finds 6-10% of reference answers contestable. The dataset supports generative, extractive and retrieval-augmented QA as well as zero- and few-shot LLM evaluation. We report fine-tuned baselines (IndoBERT variants, mT5, RAG) with 5-fold cross-validation, learning curves and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, and benchmark eight contemporary LLMs zero- and five-shot. We further calibrate our LLM-as-judge rubric against three expert raters (one RD, two nutritionists), finding it human-comparable on factuality and completeness but unreliable on clinical safety, and a human error analysis shows it misses unsupported content that the raters identify. IndoNutriQA is released to foster research in Indonesian clinical NLP and nutritional decision support.
zh_abstract: 临床问答（Question Answering, QA）是临床智能决策支持系统的基础，但对于印度尼西亚语等低资源语言，由于缺乏公开的领域特定数据，进展受到严重限制。我们推出IndoNutriQA，这是一个由专家策划的印度尼西亚语临床QA基准，包含911个问答对，构建自真实临床营养报告。它并非大规模训练语料，而是定位为高质量评估资源：每个问答对都以临床相关上下文为基础，并富含结构化元数据（人体测量评估、医学诊断、文档来源、片段分割）。每份报告均回答遵循营养护理流程（Nutrition Care Process, NCP）的八种标准化问题类型，包括问题、病因、体征和症状（Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom, PES）诊断陈述；每份报告由一名研究生级营养学实习生撰写，并由三名营养师之一作答。答案采用自由形式的临床文本，而非抽取式片段；一项专家验证研究发现6-10%的参考答案存在争议。该数据集支持生成式、抽取式和检索增强式QA，以及零样本和少样本LLM评估。我们报告了经微调的基线模型（IndoBERT变体、mT5、RAG）及5折交叉验证、学习曲线和bootstrap 95%置信区间，并对八个当代LLM进行了零样本和五样本基准测试。我们进一步以三名专家评分者（一名注册营养师（RD）、两名营养师）校准LLM作为评判者的评分标准，发现其在事实性和完整性上可与人类相当，但在临床安全性上不可靠；人工错误分析显示，它漏掉了评分者识别出的无支持内容。IndoNutriQA已发布，以促进印度尼西亚语临床NLP和营养决策支持研究。

title: A Visual Grounding Benchmark for Retinal OCT with Multimodal Large Language Models
zh_title: 视网膜OCT多模态大模型视觉定位基准
summary: 发布RetinaGroundBench，含815张OCT B扫描、4537个专家标注框，评测27个开源多模态模型。
key_points: 815张B扫描覆盖13种生物标志物
4,537个标注框、8类疾病
提出AggIoU指标量化定位覆盖度
reason: 新公开眼科OCT定位基准并有基线对比，规模中等，属预印本5-6档
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer clinical questions about medical images, but trustworthy use requires visual grounding: models should localize the pathology they report rather than rely on spurious shortcuts. Whether MLLMs can visually ground clinical findings in retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT), the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology, remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce RetinaGroundBench, the first benchmark for biomarker visual grounding in retinal OCT. It comprises 815 B-scans exhaustively annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes covering 13 biomarkers across 8 diseases. Because MLLMs often fragment a single lesion into multiple partial predictions, we propose AggIoU, a metric that evaluates whether the union of overlapping predicted boxes covers the annotated region. Across 27 open-source MLLMs (0.8-38B parameters), we find that visual grounding remains largely unsolved: the best general-purpose model achieves a macro F1 of just 23.7%, with consistently low recall, despite reaching up to 73% balanced accuracy on biomarker presence questions. To narrow this gap, we developed RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned using an OCT-specific strategy integrating grounding and textual information. Despite its relatively small size (8B), RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement. Our benchmark provides a reference point for measuring progress in the field of OCT diagnosis with MLLMs.
zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能够回答关于医学图像的临床问题，但要可信使用需要视觉定位：模型应定位其报告的病理，而不是依赖虚假的捷径。MLLMs能否在视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）——眼科最广泛使用的成像模态——中对临床发现进行视觉定位，仍基本未被探索。为填补这一空白，我们推出RetinaGroundBench，这是首个用于视网膜OCT生物标志物视觉定位的基准。它包含815张B扫描，由眼科医生详尽标注，共有4,537个边界框，覆盖8种疾病中的13种生物标志物。由于MLLMs常将单个病灶拆分为多个部分预测，我们提出AggIoU，一种评估重叠预测框的并集是否覆盖标注区域的指标。在27个开源MLLMs（0.8-38B参数）中，我们发现视觉定位在很大程度上仍未解决：最佳通用模型的宏F1仅23.7%，召回率持续偏低，尽管其在生物标志物存在性问题上的平衡准确率最高可达73%。为缩小这一差距，我们开发了RetGrounder，这是一种采用整合定位与文本信息的OCT专用策略微调的MLLM。尽管规模相对较小（8B），RetGrounder将定位F1提高到33.9%，相对提升43%。我们的基准为衡量MLLMs在OCT诊断领域的进展提供了参照点。

title: Diagnostic Loss: Asymmetric Supervision for Radiology Report Generation
zh_title: Diagnostic Loss：面向放射报告生成的非对称监督
summary: 预印本指出常规 token 级最大似然目标与放射报告诊断要求错配，提出直接在解码器概率上操作的可微、架构无关损失函数。
key_points: 问题：模型漏报关键诊断并引入错误诊断
DLoss 分别聚合有支持与无支持诊断词的概率
方法宣称与架构无关、可微
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要未给出充分对比与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated radiology report generation requires models to do more than produce fluent clinical narratives: they must explicitly state supported diagnoses while avoiding unsupported ones. However, existing medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) are typically trained with token-level maximum likelihood objectives, which prioritize text agreement over diagnostically critical terms. As a result, models can miss key diagnoses and introduce wrong ones. We identify this as an objective misalignment between conventional language modeling and the asymmetric diagnostic requirements of radiology reporting. To encode these requirements, we introduce Diagnostic Loss (DLoss), a differentiable, architecture-agnostic objective that operates directly on decoder token probabilities. DLoss separately aggregates probability mass over vocabularies associated with diagnoses supported by the reference report and with unsupported alternatives. Using asymmetric pooling across token positions in the report, it encourages supported diagnoses to receive sufficient probability in at least one position while suppressing spurious probability spikes for unsupported diagnoses across all positions during training. The loss can be applied to existing 3D MedVLMs without modifying their vision backbones, language decoders, or inference procedures, and introduces no additional inference-time computation. We train and evaluate DLoss on 50,000 abdominal CT scans across several 3D MedVLM architectures on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution report-generation benchmarks. Across these settings, DLoss improves diagnostic faithfulness while maintaining competitive performance on conventional language-generation metrics, showing the value of asymmetric sequence-level supervision for radiology report generation. The code for DLoss is available at https://github.com/gmum/DLoss.
zh_abstract: 自动放射学报告生成要求模型不仅仅生成流畅的临床叙述：它们必须明确陈述有支持的诊断，同时避免无支持的诊断。然而，现有的医学视觉-语言模型（medical vision-language models, MedVLMs）通常使用 token 级最大似然目标进行训练，该目标优先考虑文本一致性而非诊断关键术语。因此，模型可能遗漏关键诊断并引入错误诊断。我们将此识别为传统语言建模与放射学报告的非对称诊断要求之间的目标错位。为了编码这些要求，我们引入了 Diagnostic Loss（DLoss），这是一种可微分、与架构无关的目标，直接作用于解码器 token 概率。DLoss 分别在与参考报告支持的诊断相关的词汇表以及无支持的替代诊断相关的词汇表上聚合概率质量。利用报告内 token 位置上的非对称池化，它鼓励有支持的诊断在至少一个位置上获得足够概率，同时在训练期间抑制所有位置上无支持诊断的虚假概率峰值。该损失可应用于现有的 3D MedVLMs，而无需修改其视觉主干、语言解码器或推理过程，并且不引入额外的推理时计算。我们在 50,000 例腹部 CT 扫描上，在多种 3D MedVLM 架构上，针对分布内和分布外报告生成基准训练并评估了 DLoss。在这些设置中，DLoss 提高了诊断忠实度，同时在传统语言生成指标上保持有竞争力的性能，显示了非对称序列级监督对放射学报告生成的价值。DLoss 的代码可在 https://github.com/gmum/DLoss 获取。

title: GWDM: A Guided Wavelet Diffusion Model for Realistic Histopathology Image Generation
zh_title: GWDM：用于生成逼真病理图像的引导小波扩散模型
summary: 预印本提出小波扩散框架，以组织形态与染色等病理领域特征为条件控制，合成病理图像用于数据增广。
key_points: 针对病理标注数据稀缺的增广需求
用小波捕捉多尺度图像细节
引入组织学特征的可控条件生成
reason: 预印本生成方法，思路有新意但摘要未给出充分定量对比与外部验证
abstract: Histopathology images are recognized as a reliable and comprehensive modality for Deep Learning (DL) based diagnosis. However, effectiveness is constrained by limited large-scale annotated datasets, as collecting expert-labeled medical data is costly and time-intensive. Recent advances in generative models, particularly diffusion models, demonstrate strong capabilities in synthesizing medically relevant content for dataset augmentation. Existing generative frameworks treat histopathology patches as generic natural images, failing to enforce biological constraints such as histomorphological structures and heterogeneous staining patterns essential for valid synthesis. We propose a guided wavelet diffusion model (GWDM) framework that captures image details at multiple scales using wavelets and leverages controllable conditioning based on domain-specific histopathological features (e.g., tissue patterns and color variations). We further formulate a histomorphological guidance loss applied to real and generated patches. A loss ramping strategy gradually introduces these constraints during training, ensuring stable optimization and robust modeling of tissue architecture. GWDM was evaluated on three benchmark datasets (BCSS, MoNuSeg, and PAIP2019), consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative methods. Ablation studies confirmed that domain-guided conditioning, perceptual loss, and structural similarity loss each contribute meaningfully to synthesis quality. Downstream nuclei and tissue segmentation experiments further validated the clinical utility of GWDM-generated images, demonstrating consistent performance improvements when synthetic data augments real training sets. This work shows that domain-specific conditioning and dual-loss optimization generate realistic histopathology patches, reducing data scarcity and improving clinical downstream segmentation performance.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学图像被认为是基于深度学习（Deep Learning, DL）诊断的可靠且全面的模态。然而，其有效性受到有限的大规模标注数据集的制约，因为收集专家标注的医学数据成本高昂且耗时。生成模型（尤其是扩散模型）的最新进展在合成医学相关内容以进行数据集增强方面展现出强大能力。现有的生成框架将组织病理学图像块视为通用自然图像，未能施加对有效合成至关重要的生物学约束，例如组织形态学结构和异质性染色模式。我们提出了一种引导小波扩散模型（guided wavelet diffusion model, GWDM）框架，该框架使用小波在多个尺度上捕捉图像细节，并利用基于领域特定组织病理学特征（例如组织模式和颜色变化）的可控条件。我们进一步构建了应用于真实和生成图像块的组织形态学引导损失。损失渐进策略在训练期间逐步引入这些约束，确保稳定优化和组织结构的稳健建模。GWDM 在三个基准数据集（BCSS、MoNuSeg 和 PAIP2019）上进行了评估，始终优于最先进的生成方法。消融研究证实，领域引导条件、感知损失和结构相似性损失均对合成质量有实质性贡献。下游细胞核和组织分割实验进一步验证了 GWDM 生成图像的临床效用，证明合成数据增强真实训练集时性能持续改善。这项工作表明，领域特定条件和双损失优化可生成逼真的组织病理学图像块，减少数据稀缺并改善临床下游分割性能。

title: Evaluating Type-1 Diabetes Digital Twins by Decision Quality
zh_title: 以决策质量评估1型糖尿病数字孪生
summary: 提出按下游治疗排序的决策质量而非血糖轨迹精度来评估1型糖尿病数字孪生，并在虚拟患者数据上验证。
key_points: 以治疗排序是否符合真实患者来评价数字孪生
基于UVA/Padova模型30名虚拟患者、21种基础-餐时方案
预印本，属于方法学评估，未经同行评审
reason: 评估视角有新意但仅在虚拟患者上验证，证据有限，属5-6档
abstract: A digital twin (DT) for type 1 diabetes (T1D) can predict how an individual's blood glucose will respond to different insulin treatments without actually trying them. For each treatment, downstream statistics of predicted glucose trajectories, such as glycemic risk, can be computed to guide clinical decisions. However, the quality of DTs is usually measured by the accuracy of their predicted glucose trajectories, which may not reflect the quality of the downstream treatment decisions they inform. In this work, we directly evaluate DTs by this decision quality on downstream treatment ranking, i.e., whether a DT predicts glucose trajectories that can be used to rank candidate treatments as the real patient would. We present an evaluation protocol over 30 virtual patients from the FDA-accepted UVA/Padova model, each simulated under 21 different basal-bolus treatments. For each patient, a DT is fitted under one treatment and then produces glucose trajectories for the remaining 20 treatments. Our results show that prediction accuracy and decision quality disagree. A baseline that models the average patient, never seeing the individual's glucose data, has the lowest prediction accuracy of all six methods (RMSE: 63.6 mg/dL) but ranks treatments with the second-highest mean Spearman (0.766), while a black-box neural network that predicts glucose nearly twice as accurately (RMSE: 32.9 mg/dL) ranks them no better than a random ordering of the 20 treatments (0.049 Spearman). Therefore, selecting a DT based on prediction accuracy alone can prefer one that recommends treatments at chance, and decision quality must be evaluated directly rather than assumed to follow from prediction accuracy.
zh_abstract: 1型糖尿病（type 1 diabetes, T1D）的数字孪生（digital twin, DT）可以预测个体血糖对不同胰岛素治疗的反应，而无需实际尝试这些治疗。对于每种治疗，可计算预测血糖轨迹的下游统计量（如血糖风险），以指导临床决策。然而，DT的质量通常以其预测血糖轨迹的准确性来衡量，而这可能无法反映其所支持的下游治疗决策的质量。在这项工作中，我们直接通过下游治疗排序上的决策质量来评估DT，即DT预测的血糖轨迹能否像真实患者那样对候选治疗进行排序。我们提出一项评估方案，涵盖来自美国FDA认可的UVA/Padova模型的30名虚拟患者，每名患者均在21种不同的基础-餐时胰岛素治疗下进行模拟。对于每名患者，DT在一种治疗下拟合，然后为其余20种治疗生成血糖轨迹。我们的结果表明，预测准确性和决策质量并不一致。一个对平均患者建模、从未见过该个体血糖数据的基线方法，在全部六种方法中预测准确性最低（RMSE：63.6 mg/dL），但其治疗排序的平均Spearman相关系数第二高（0.766）；而一个将血糖预测准确性提高近一倍的黑箱神经网络（RMSE：32.9 mg/dL），其治疗排序并不优于对20种治疗的随机排序（Spearman 0.049）。因此，仅基于预测准确性选择DT，可能会偏向于选择一个相当于随机水平推荐治疗的DT，决策质量必须直接评估，而不能假定其会随预测准确性而来。

title: ICGF-CXRMate: Image-Conditioned Clinical Context Compression and Gated Fusion for Chest X-ray Report Generation
zh_title: ICGF-CXRMate：胸片报告生成的临床上下文压缩
summary: 提出以图像为条件的临床上下文压缩与门控融合框架，在MIMIC-CXR与MIMIC-IV-ED关联数据上提升报告质量并缩短提示长度。
key_points: 可学习查询先以胸片表征为条件，再压缩患者数据序列
门控交叉注意力选择性融合临床token，并保留直接临床通路
在MIMIC关联数据上报告报告质量提升、平均提示长度下降
reason: 有新方法且有基线对比，但为预印本、公开数据集内部评估
abstract: Auxiliary patient data can improve chest X-ray report generation, but directly concatenating heterogeneous clinical information with visual tokens produces long, variable-length decoder prompts and may expose the model to redundant or image-irrelevant context. We propose ICGF-CXRMate, an image-conditioned clinical context compression and gated fusion framework. Learnable queries are first conditioned on the current chest X-ray representations and then attend to the patient-data sequence, compressing it into a fixed number of clinical context tokens. Gated cross-attention selectively integrates these tokens into the visual stream, while the compressed tokens are retained in the decoder prompt as a direct clinical pathway. Experiments on linked MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-IV-ED examinations show that ICGF-CXRMate improves report quality while reducing the average prompt length. In Stage~2, it improves RadGraph-F1 from 24.00 to 28.86, CXR-BERT similarity from 56.86 to 62.80, and BLEU-4 from 5.14 to 7.96 compared with CXRMate-ED, while reducing the average prompt length from 373.89 to 288.37 tokens, corresponding to a 22.9\% reduction. After self-critical sequence training, ICGF-CXRMate outperforms CXRMate-ED on six of eight report-quality metrics in Stage~3. Ablation studies confirm the complementary contributions of image-conditioned compression, gated fusion, and direct retention of the compressed clinical tokens.
zh_abstract: 辅助患者数据可以改善胸部X射线报告生成，但将异质性临床信息与视觉token直接拼接会产生长且可变长度的解码器提示，并可能使模型暴露于冗余或与图像无关的上下文。我们提出ICGF-CXRMate，一个图像条件化的临床上下文压缩与门控融合框架。可学习查询首先以当前胸部X射线表示为条件，然后关注患者数据序列，将其压缩为固定数量的临床上下文token。门控交叉注意力选择性地将这些token整合到视觉流中，同时压缩后的token保留在解码器提示中作为直接临床通路。在关联的MIMIC-CXR和MIMIC-IV-ED检查上的实验表明，ICGF-CXRMate在提高报告质量的同时缩短了平均提示长度。在Stage~2中，与CXRMate-ED相比，它将RadGraph-F1从24.00提高到28.86，将CXR-BERT相似度从56.86提高到62.80，将BLEU-4从5.14提高到7.96，同时将平均提示长度从373.89个token减少到288.37个token，相当于减少22.9%。经过自我批判序列训练（self-critical sequence training）后，ICGF-CXRMate在Stage~3中在八项报告质量指标中的六项上优于CXRMate-ED。消融研究证实了图像条件化压缩、门控融合以及压缩临床token的直接保留的互补贡献。

title: A General-Purpose Dual-Path Interaction Framework for Multi-View Medical Image Segmentation: Alleviating Data Volume Dependency in Small-Sample Regimes
zh_title: 多视角医学图像分割的双路径交互框架
summary: 预印本提出即插即用的双路径交互框架 DPIF，利用跨视角解剖互补性缓解小样本下的分割性能下降。
key_points: 基于 Sinkhorn 最优传输做跨视角分布对齐
不要求样本级配对，兼容任意编码器-解码器网络
以条件互信息引导特征交互，降低标注依赖
reason: 有新方法且面向小样本分割，但为预印本、外部验证情况不明，值得一看档
abstract: The performance of medical image segmentation depends on a large amount of annotated data, and most segmentation models experience a significant drop in performance in low-sample-size scenarios. Existing semi-supervised and weakly supervised methods rely on specific network architectures, while traditional multi-view-assisted segmentation methods require strictly paired samples, which limits their clinical applications. To address these issues, we propose DPIF, a general-purpose plug-and-play dual-path interaction framework compatible with arbitrary encoder-decoder segmentation networks, which leverages cross-view anatomical complementarity to reduce annotation reliance. DPIF first performs Sinkhorn optimal transport-based cross-view distribution alignment to establish global semantic correspondence without sample-level pairing. It then adopts conditional mutual information-guided feature decoupling to enable bidirectional knowledge transfer only within the shared semantic space, suppressing view-specific noise. Finally, persistent homology-based topological regularization encodes anatomical invariants as unsupervised priors to mitigate overfitting. Experiments were conducted using 24 baseline models on a private multicenter echocardiography dataset and two public datasets. The results show that DPIF-enhanced models outperform single-view baseline models when trained on comparable amounts of data. Notably, most dual-path variants trained on 40\% - 60\% of the data achieve performance comparable to that of single-view models trained on the full dataset. This demonstrates that DPIF provides a general-purpose and scalable solution for data-scarce multi-view medical image segmentation problems.
zh_abstract: 医学图像分割的性能依赖于大量标注数据，而大多数分割模型在低样本量场景下会经历性能的显著下降。现有的半监督和弱监督方法依赖于特定的网络架构，而传统的多视图辅助分割方法要求严格配对的样本，这限制了其临床应用。为解决这些问题，我们提出 DPIF，一种通用即插即用的双路径交互框架，兼容任意编码器-解码器分割网络，利用跨视图解剖互补性来减少对标注的依赖。DPIF 首先执行基于 Sinkhorn 最优传输的跨视图分布对齐，以在无需样本级配对的情况下建立全局语义对应。然后采用条件互信息引导的特征解耦，仅在共享语义空间内实现双向知识迁移，抑制视图特有噪声。最后，基于持久同调的拓扑正则化将解剖不变量编码为无监督先验，以缓解过拟合。实验使用 24 个基线模型在一个私有多中心超声心动图数据集和两个公共数据集上进行。结果表明，在可比数据量上训练时，DPIF 增强模型优于单视图基线模型。值得注意的是，大多数在 40%–60% 数据上训练的双路径变体达到与在全数据集上训练的单视图模型相当的性能。这表明 DPIF 为数据稀缺的多视图医学图像分割问题提供了一种通用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: CVP-BAA: Efficiently Adapting Segment Anything Model for Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: CVP-BAA：高效适配SAM用于医学图像分割
summary: arXiv预印本提出混合参数高效微调方法CVP-BAA，为SAM引入局部结构先验，提升医学分割的边界刻画能力。
key_points: 针对SAM的prompt与adapter微调忽略局部先验
混合PEFT方法增强对域内纹理细节的敏感性
目标为改善分割边界描绘
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，但摘要未见量化对比与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Various task-specific medical segmentation models have demonstrated strong performance, their heavy reliance on extensive annotations and highly specialized architectures limits their versatility, scalability, and clinical applicability. Recently, adapting vision foundation models, particularly the segment anything model (SAM), has emerged as a promising alternative. However, prevalent parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategies, such as prompt tuning and adapter tuning, often lack an explicit mechanism to embed local structural priors into the long-range dependency modeling of vision transformers (ViT), rendering them insufficiently sensitive to fine-grained details. To address these limitations, we introduce CVP-BAA, a novel hybrid PEFT method that improves SAM's sensitivity to domain-specific textures and local details, leading to superior boundary delineation. The proposed CVP-BAA adopts two key ideas. First, it introduces a convolutional visual prompting (CVP) strategy that leverages convolutional features as structural priors, prepending them to the key and value projections within the multi-head self-attention layers of strategically selected ViT blocks. Through a dedicated prompt generation-and-injection module, this mechanism effectively bridges local spatial details with global context semantics. Second, a boundary-aware adapter (BAA) is designed as a parallel branch to the feed-forward network within the same selected blocks. By explicitly computing and amplifying high-frequency components, the BAA enhances feature representations along tissue boundaries and fine-grained lesion structures. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks across three imaging modalities demonstrate that CVP-BAA achieves superior segmentation performance, surpassing existing task-specific models and PEFT-based SAM adaptations in both quantitative metrics and qualitative results.
zh_abstract: 各种任务特定的医学分割模型已展现出强大性能，但它们对大量标注和高度专业化架构的严重依赖限制了其通用性、可扩展性和临床适用性。最近，适配视觉基础模型，尤其是分割一切模型（SAM），已成为一种有前景的替代方案。然而，常见的参数高效微调（PEFT）策略，如提示调优和适配器调优，通常缺乏显式机制来将局部结构先验嵌入视觉Transformer（ViT）的远程依赖建模中，使其对细粒度细节不够敏感。为解决这些局限，我们提出CVP-BAA，一种新颖的混合PEFT方法，可提高SAM对领域特定纹理和局部细节的敏感性，从而实现更优的边界描绘。所提出的CVP-BAA采用两个关键思想。首先，它引入卷积视觉提示（CVP）策略，利用卷积特征作为结构先验，将其前置到策略性选择的ViT块中多头自注意力层内的键和值投影之前。通过专用的提示生成与注入模块，该机制有效桥接局部空间细节与全局上下文语义。其次，边界感知适配器（BAA）被设计为与相同选定块内前馈网络并行的分支。通过显式计算并放大高频成分，BAA增强了沿组织边界和细粒度病变结构的特征表示。在三种成像模态的五个基准上的大量实验表明，CVP-BAA实现了更优的分割性能，在定量指标和定性结果上均优于现有任务特定模型和基于PEFT的SAM适配方法。

title: Text-Only LLM Correctors Break Correct Transcripts: A Repair-Damage Analysis of Audio Grounding in ASR Error Correction
zh_title: 纯文本大模型纠错会破坏已正确转写：语音信息作用分析
summary: arXiv预印本将ASR纠错的WER变化拆解为修复、破坏与插入三类，发现在多个语料上纯文本纠错会破坏13–32%本已正确的转写，而提供音频时降至1–3%。
key_points: 精确分解WER为修复、破坏、插入三类
纯文本纠错破坏13–32%正确转写
在医疗听写中保留的插入抵消净增益
reason: 分析角度新颖且有医疗听写语料，但为预印本、两臂提示词不同，属值得一看档
abstract: LLM correctors of ASR output are judged by aggregate WER, which hides what they fix and what they break. We decompose every WER change exactly into repaired tokens, damaged tokens and insertions, and use this to ask what the source audio adds to a corrector. We compare correction with and without the audio, for the model's own draft and for the output of an independent recogniser, on three corpora. With Gemini 2.5 Flash, text-only correction of its own draft breaks 13-32% of already-correct transcripts; with the audio, 1-3%. Damage falls in both settings. Repair falls against the own draft and rises against the recogniser. On medical dictation, kept insertions cancel the gain in net WER. The open-weight Voxtral, which rarely edits, does not show this pattern. Prompts differ between the two arms, so the contrasts bound the effect of the audio and do not isolate it.
zh_abstract: 用于纠正自动语音识别（ASR）输出的大语言模型（LLM）纠正器以总体词错误率（WER）评判，而这掩盖了它们修复了什么、破坏了什么。我们将每一处 WER 变化精确分解为修复的词元、损坏的词元和插入，并借此追问源音频为纠正器增加了什么。我们在三个语料库上，针对模型自身草稿和独立识别器的输出，比较有音频和无音频时的纠正。使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 时，仅文本纠正其自身草稿会破坏 13–32% 的已正确转录文本；有音频时为 1–3%。两种设置下损坏均下降。修复在针对自身草稿时下降，在针对独立识别器时上升。在医学口述中，保留下来的插入抵消了净 WER 的改善。开放权重（open-weight）的 Voxtral 很少编辑，未表现出这一模式。两个实验组之间的提示词不同，因此这些对比限定了音频效应的范围，而并未将其分离出来。

title: Revealing Hidden Failure Modes in Chest X-ray Classification via Spectral Domain Analysis
zh_title: 频谱分析揭示胸片分类隐藏失效模式
summary: 用频域能量谱聚类发现胸片分类模型失效集中于特定频谱簇，可预测可靠性盲区。
key_points: 将图像投影至频域提取紧凑信号能量谱
对频谱谱做无监督聚类定位失效集中区
可据此预测模型可靠性与发现盲点
reason: 数据为中心的失效分析有新意，预印本且未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Deep learning models for chest X-ray anomaly detection remain vulnerable to subtle distributional shifts (e.g., acquisition technique, patient-related factors, and preprocessing). Traditional error analysis often relies on semantic metadata or model embeddings, which can mask low-level signal variations that degrade performance. In this work, we propose a data-centric framework for automated failure mode discovery using spectral analysis. We project images into the frequency domain and extract a compact profile summarizing the distribution of signal energy across frequency bands. By performing unsupervised clustering on these spectral profiles, we demonstrate that model failures are not randomly distributed, but are strongly concentrated within specific spectral clusters. This method effectively isolates "blind spots", enabling the prediction of model reliability and the discovery of performance-degrading data slices without requiring ground-truth failure annotations.
zh_abstract: 用于胸部X线异常检测的深度学习模型仍然容易受到细微分布偏移的影响（例如采集技术、患者相关因素和预处理）。传统错误分析通常依赖语义元数据或模型嵌入，这可能掩盖会降低性能的低层信号变化。在本工作中，我们提出一个以数据为中心、使用频谱分析进行自动化失效模式发现的框架。我们将图像投影到频域，并提取一个紧凑剖面，概括信号能量在各频带上的分布。通过对这些频谱剖面进行无监督聚类，我们证明模型失效并非随机分布，而是强烈集中在特定频谱簇内。该方法有效分离出“盲点”，无需真实失效标注即可预测模型可靠性并发现降低性能的数据切片。

title: Reliability-Aware Probabilistic Fusion for Multimodal Learning with Incomplete Evidence
zh_title: 面向不完整证据的多模态可靠性概率融合
summary: 提出可靠性感知高斯专家乘积融合方法，在模态缺失时提升两项临床多模态任务的平均AUROC。
key_points: 可靠性权重按输入调节各模态隐变量精度
缺失模态专家直接省略，并做缺失感知训练
在HAIM-MIMIC-MM等两项临床任务上验证
reason: 新方法预印本，有基线对比与消融，但外部验证不清、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Multimodal inputs may be missing or degraded, raising distinct questions of evidence availability and trust. We introduce a reliability-aware Gaussian Product-of-Experts (PoE) in which an input-dependent reliability weight tempers each modality's latent precision, while missing experts are omitted. We characterize how reliability and availability affect posterior information and expert influence. Across two clinical multimodal tasks, the full framework remains competitive with complete inputs and achieves its clearest mean-AUROC advantage under modality absence, particularly on HAIM-MIMIC-MM. Ablations show a substantial gain from missing-aware training and an additional HAIM improvement from reliability weighting under matched PoE, missing-aware, and consistency training. Unseen test-time corruptions are used diagnostically and reveal modality-dependent reliability-weight and latent-uncertainty responses, including failure under severe degradation. Thus, reliability weighting provides an explicit evidence-control mechanism, while learning dependable quality signals remains an open challenge.
zh_abstract: 多模态输入可能缺失或退化，这提出了关于证据可用性和信任的不同问题。我们引入一种可靠性感知的高斯专家乘积（Gaussian Product-of-Experts, PoE），其中依赖输入的可靠性权重调节每个模态的潜在精度，同时缺失的专家被省略。我们刻画了可靠性和可用性如何影响后验信息和专家影响。在两个临床多模态任务中，完整框架在输入完整时仍具竞争力，并在模态缺失下取得其最明显的平均 AUROC 优势，尤其是在 HAIM-MIMIC-MM 上。消融实验显示，缺失感知训练（missing-aware training）带来显著增益，并且在匹配的 PoE、缺失感知训练和一致性训练下，可靠性加权还带来额外的 HAIM 改善。未见过的测试时损坏（unseen test-time corruptions）被用于诊断，并揭示了依赖模态的可靠性权重和潜在不确定性响应，包括在严重退化下的失败。因此，可靠性加权提供了一种显式的证据控制机制，而学习可靠的质量信号仍是一个开放挑战。

title: TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation
zh_title: TernScope：高效三值内镜分割的软硬件协同设计
summary: 通过模型与硬件协同设计实现三值权重内镜分割网络，在域内与外部数据集保持竞争性精度。
key_points: 25个卷积全用三值权重、8位激活，免乘法
0.2483M参数、0.0949 GMACs，面向边缘推理
域内与外部数据集上精度具竞争力
reason: 高效内镜分割预印本，含外部数据集评估，但属工程优化、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) then adapts the fused network from deep to shallow layers, through the decoder, and finally to the input and prediction layers. All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation. The resulting model uses 0.2483 M parameters and 0.0949 GMACs while retaining competitive segmentation accuracy on in-domain and external datasets. Under the same 45 nm technology, TernScope reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the original Gemmini, a systolic-array accelerator with 8-bit $\times$ 8-bit multipliers. These results demonstrate a path from accurate lightweight medical segmentation to compact low-bit hardware.
zh_abstract: 边缘医学分割必须兼顾小模型尺寸、高精度和快速推理。TernScope 通过模型—硬件协同设计来应对这一权衡，学习一个紧凑的分割网络，其低位宽算子也简化了硬件执行。分通道大核模块以有限计算保留空间上下文，而分支融合移除冗余推理路径。三值渐进量化感知训练（Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training, TPQ）随后使融合网络从深层到浅层、经过解码器、最终到输入层和预测层进行适配。全部 25 个卷积使用三值权重和 8 位激活，从而实现打包存储和无乘法器计算。所得模型使用 0.2483 M 参数和 0.0949 GMACs，同时在域内和外部数据集上保持有竞争力的分割精度。在相同 45 nm 工艺下，与原始 Gemmini（一种具有 8 位 × 8 位乘法器的脉动阵列加速器）相比，TernScope 将计算阵列面积减少 88.46%。这些结果展示了一条从准确的轻量级医学分割到紧凑低位宽硬件的路径。

title: Learning to Measure and Diagnose: A Clinical-Dictionary Radiomic Bottleneck Model for Thyroid Nodule Classification
zh_title: 临床词典影像组学瓶颈模型用于甲状腺结节分类
summary: 提出面向甲状腺超声的临床词典影像组学瓶颈模型，以可解释测量证据辅助结节分类。
key_points: FARL 在特征族间平衡监督估计测量
FGBM 构建固定瓶颈并联合优化
模型以临床词典测量作为可解释证据
reason: 预印本新方法，强调可解释但未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Thyroid ultrasound supports the assessment of nodule malignancy, but classification predictions often lack evidence linked to familiar clinical descriptions. Radiomics provides explicitly defined measurements that can support such explanations through a clinical dictionary. However, using these measurements as interpretable evidence requires reliable estimation from ultrasound images and preservation of measurement fidelity when optimizing classification performance. We propose a clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model for thyroid nodule classification. Within this model, Family-Aware Radiomic Learning (FARL) estimates measurements with balanced supervision across feature families. Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling (FGBM) constructs a fixed bottleneck, followed by joint optimization of measurement estimation and classification under fidelity guidance. Decision evidence decomposition then traces feature contributions through a linear classifier and organizes them by clinical dictionary categories. Experiments on ThyroidXL and TN3K show competitive classification performance, while case studies illustrate feature contributions for benign and malignant nodules. These findings indicate interpretable classification with inspectable quantitative evidence informed by clinical knowledge. Code is available online.
zh_abstract: 甲状腺超声支持对结节恶性程度的评估，但分类预测往往缺乏与常见临床描述相关联的证据。放射组学提供了明确定义的测量指标，可通过临床词典支持此类解释。然而，将这些测量指标用作可解释证据，需要从超声图像中进行可靠估计，并在优化分类性能时保持测量保真度。我们提出一种用于甲状腺结节分类的临床词典放射组学瓶颈模型。在该模型中，特征族感知的放射组学学习（Family-Aware Radiomic Learning, FARL）通过对各特征族的平衡监督来估计测量指标。保真度引导的瓶颈建模（Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling, FGBM）构建固定瓶颈，随后在保真度引导下联合优化测量估计和分类。决策证据分解随后通过线性分类器追踪特征贡献，并按临床词典类别组织这些贡献。在 ThyroidXL 和 TN3K 上的实验显示出有竞争力的分类性能，而案例研究展示了良性和恶性结节的特征贡献。这些发现表明，能够实现可解释分类，并具有由临床知识提供信息的、可检查的定量证据。代码可在线获取。

title: Generative AI-Assisted Teaching and Clinical Reasoning Among TCM Interns
zh_title: 生成式AI辅助中医实习生临床推理教学试验
summary: 台湾三分院区开展非随机整群对照教育干预，评估ChatGPT辅助教学对中医实习生临床推理的影响。
key_points: 非随机整群对照，按训练院区分组
干预组接受3小时ChatGPT入门培训
样本38人，已完成，尚无结果
reason: 小样本非随机教育研究且无结果，属小样本增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Taipei City Hospital; conditions: Clinical, Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 38; status: COMPLETED] This study evaluated the effects of generative artificial intelligence (GAI)-assisted education on clinical reasoning performance among traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) interns. An assessor-blinded, nonrandomized, cluster-controlled educational intervention study was conducted at three hospital branches in Taiwan. Participants were assigned to either a GAI-assisted education group or a conventional education group according to their clinical training sites. The intervention group received a three-hour introductory training session on ChatGPT and was encouraged to use the tool independently for clinical case analysis during subsequent clinical rotations. The control group received conventional clinical education without structured GAI-assisted training. The primary outcome was clinical reasoning performance, assessed through clinical case reports independently evaluated by two blinded TCM educators. Secondary outcomes included perceptions of the four-element TCM diagnostic framework and perceptions of GAI-assisted learning.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Taipei City Hospital；疾病/条件：Clinical、Education；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：38；状态：COMPLETED] 本研究评估了生成式人工智能（GAI）辅助教育对中医（TCM）实习生临床推理表现的影响。在台湾三家医院分院开展了一项评估者盲法、非随机、整群对照的教育干预研究。参与者根据其临床培训地点被分配到 GAI 辅助教育组或传统教育组。干预组接受了为期三小时的 ChatGPT 入门培训课程，并被鼓励在随后的临床轮转中独立使用该工具进行临床病例分析。对照组接受传统临床教育，未接受结构化的 GAI 辅助培训。主要结局是临床推理表现，通过由两名盲法中医教育者独立评估的临床病例报告进行评估。次要结局包括对四要素中医诊断框架的认知以及对 GAI 辅助学习的认知。

title: Explainable AI for Prospective Pressure Injury Staging
zh_title: 可解释AI用于压力性损伤分期的前瞻性观察研究

使用标准化临床照片与专家小组标注图像

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: hatice akaltun; conditions: Pressure Injury; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 415; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This prospective observational mixed-methods study aims to develop and evaluate an explainable artificial intelligence model for staging pressure injuries using standardized clinical photographs and expert panel-labeled images from adult patients. The study will also explore nurses' views on the clinical acceptability and usability of the decision-support system through semi-structured interviews.

title: Comparative performance of Gemini and DeepSeek large language models in surgical decision support for mastoidectomy in chronic otitis media with cholesteatoma.
zh_title: Gemini与DeepSeek在乳突根治术决策支持中的比较
summary: 以121例胆脂瘤型中耳炎手术病例，由4名耳鼻喉专家百分制评分比较两模型建议。
key_points: 回顾性纳入121例乳突根治术病例
输入耳镜、纯音测听与影像资料
手术规划与术后管理两域均无显著差异
reason: 小样本回顾性、单中心、专家评分无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] To compare the clinical accuracy of two state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs), Gemini Pro v3.1 and DeepSeek v3.2, in providing surgical decision support and postoperative management for mastoidectomy using expert-validated real patient data. A retrospective analysis included 121 mastoidectomy cases performed for chronic otitis media with cholesteatoma. Clinical case scenarios, including otoscopy, pure-tone audiometry, and radiological findings, were presented to both models. AI-generated responses were evaluated using a 100-point scoring system developed by four otolaryngologists in two domains: surgical planning and postoperative management. Paired-sample t-tests compared model performance, while Mann-Whitney U and Kruskal-Wallis tests assessed the effects of clinical variables. No significant difference was found between Gemini and DeepSeek in surgical planning (76.07% vs. 73.97%, p = 0.258). However, Gemini significantly outperformed DeepSeek in postoperative management (67.85% vs. 62.11%, p = 0.001). Both models achieved significantly higher scores in surgical planning than postoperative care. DeepSeek demonstrated significantly higher surgical accuracy in patients with comorbidities (p = 0.004) and postoperative complications (p < 0.001). Surgical approach significantly influenced DeepSeek's performance (p = 0.001), with better results in microscopic than endoscopic cases. Both LLMs performed well in surgical planning but were less effective in postoperative management. Gemini demonstrated superior performance in postoperative recommendations, whereas DeepSeek benefited from clearer indicators of disease severity. These findings support the potential of LLMs as adjunctive tools in otologic surgical decision-making while emphasizing the need for expert clinical oversight.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] 比较两种最先进的大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）Gemini Pro v3.1和DeepSeek v3.2，在使用专家验证的真实患者数据为乳突切除术提供手术决策支持和术后管理方面的临床准确性。一项回顾性分析纳入121例因慢性中耳炎伴胆脂瘤行乳突切除术的病例。向两个模型呈现临床病例场景，包括耳镜检查、纯音测听和影像学发现。使用由四名耳鼻咽喉科医生制定的100分评分系统，从手术计划和术后管理两个领域评估AI生成的回答。配对样本t检验比较模型表现，Mann-Whitney U检验和Kruskal-Wallis检验评估临床变量的影响。Gemini与DeepSeek在手术计划方面未发现显著差异（76.07% vs. 73.97%，p=0.258）。然而，Gemini在术后管理方面显著优于DeepSeek（67.85% vs. 62.11%，p=0.001）。两个模型在手术计划方面的得分均显著高于术后护理。DeepSeek在合并症患者（p=0.004）和术后并发症患者（p<0.001）中表现出显著更高的手术准确性。手术入路显著影响DeepSeek的表现（p=0.001），显微镜病例结果优于内镜病例。两个LLM在手术计划方面表现良好，但在术后管理方面效果较差。Gemini在术后建议方面表现更优，而DeepSeek受益于更清晰的疾病严重程度指标。这些发现支持LLM作为耳科手术决策辅助工具的潜力，同时强调需要专家临床监督。

title: Building smarter surveillance: a framework for artificial intelligence-enabled monitoring of overuse injuries in youth sports.
zh_title: 青少年运动过度使用损伤的AI监测框架
summary: 本文提出一个四支柱转化框架，用于面向青少年运动早期专项化的AI损伤监测，并指出既有模型多在成年精英男性队列中验证。
key_points: 早期专项化在青少年中日益普遍，过度使用损伤随之上升
可穿戴传感器与AI可实时量化负荷、生物力学偏差与恢复
现有AI监测模型多在成年男性精英队列验证，青少年缺乏覆盖
reason: 框架性论述，无实证数据与验证，属常规观点档
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Early sport specialization (ESS), defined as intensive, year-round training in a single sport at the exclusion of others, has become increasingly prevalent among youth athletes. This trend has coincided with a rise in overuse injuries, and premature attrition. Concurrently, advances in wearable sensors and artificial intelligence (AI) enable real-time quantification of training load, biomechanical deviations, and recovery. However, a translational gap remains: existing AI surveillance models are predominantly validated in elite adult male cohorts, leaving youth athletes underserved. To address this gap, we propose a translational four-pillar framework for ESS-aware AI injury monitoring in youth sport. Bridging technological capabilities with developmental physiology through structured AI surveillance provides a structured risk-monitoring roadmap with the potential to inform preventative strategies, optimize physical readiness, and support long-term musculoskeletal health in youth athletes.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 早期运动专项化（Early Sport Specialization, ESS）定义为排除其他运动、全年集中进行单一运动的强化训练，在青少年运动员中日益普遍。这一趋势与过度使用性损伤和过早流失的增加同时出现。与此同时，可穿戴传感器和人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的进步使得对训练负荷、生物力学偏差和恢复进行实时量化成为可能。然而，仍存在转化差距：现有AI监测模型主要在精英成年男性队列中得到验证，使青少年运动员群体服务不足。为弥补这一差距，我们提出一个用于青少年运动中ESS感知AI损伤监测的转化型四支柱框架。通过结构化AI监测将技术能力与发育生理学衔接起来，提供结构化的风险监测路线图，有望为预防策略提供信息、优化身体准备状态，并支持青少年运动员的长期肌肉骨骼健康。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Pharmacy Services: A Comparative Bibliometric Analysis of United States and Global Research Trends.
zh_title: AI在药学服务研究中的中美文献计量比较
summary: 对2015–2025年Web of Science中4426篇AI药学服务文献做计量分析，比较美国与非美国的研究产出与合作模式。
key_points: 纳入4426篇文献，美国占36.58%、非美国占63.42%
两个语料库产出均呈指数增长
分析主题演化与患者安全优先事项间的差距
reason: 文献计量趋势分析，无新方法或临床结果，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of patient safety] Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies offer transformative potential to address pharmacy workforce challenges and enhance patient safety. This study aimed to characterize the global landscape of AI research in pharmacy services and identify gaps between research activity and patient safety priorities. A bibliometric analysis was conducted on AI-pharmacy services publications indexed in Web of Science (2015-2025). Performance analysis and science mapping techniques were applied using Bibliometrix software to compare United States and non-U.S. research output, thematic evolution, and collaboration patterns. A total of 4426 documents met inclusion criteria, comprising 1619 (36.58%) United States and 2807 (63.42%) non-U.S. publications. Both corpora exhibited exponential growth. The United States contributed 29.30% of global output with higher international coauthorship rates (35.08% versus 19.91%). Thematic mapping identified "prediction" and "risk" as motor themes in U.S. research. However, co-word analysis revealed a significant translational gap: critical patient safety themes-medication error prevention and workflow optimization-were conspicuously underrepresented. Neither "medication error" nor "patient safety" appeared among high-frequency keywords despite substantial clinical relevance. Current AI-pharmacy research prioritizes algorithmic development over patient safety implementation. Strategic realignment toward medication error prevention and safety-focused applications is warranted to realize AI's potential in enhancing pharmaceutical care quality.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Patient Safety] 人工智能（AI）技术具有变革潜力，可应对药学劳动力挑战并提升患者安全。本研究旨在刻画药学服务中AI研究的全球格局，并识别研究活动与患者安全优先事项之间的差距。对Web of Science索引的2015—2025年AI-药学服务文献进行了文献计量分析。使用Bibliometrix软件应用绩效分析和科学图谱技术，比较美国与非美国的研究产出、主题演变和合作模式。共有4426篇文献符合纳入标准，包括1619篇（36.58%）美国文献和2807篇（63.42%）非美国文献。两个文献集均呈指数增长。美国贡献了全球产出的29.30%，国际合著率更高（35.08%对19.91%）。主题图谱将“预测”和“风险”确定为美国研究中的驱动主题。然而，共词分析揭示了一个显著的转化差距：关键患者安全主题——用药错误预防和工作流程优化——明显代表性不足。尽管具有重要临床相关性，“用药错误”和“患者安全”均未出现在高频关键词中。当前AI-药学研究优先考虑算法开发而非患者安全实施。有必要向用药错误预防和以安全为中心的应用进行战略性调整，以实现AI在提升药学照护质量方面的潜力。

title: Quantifying Reproducibility of Common Laboratory Tests in a Tertiary Care Hospital for More Realistic Synthetic Data in Machine Learning
zh_title: 检验项目复现性量化以生成更真实合成数据
summary: 单中心研究测量临床实验室检验的复现性范围，用于生成更真实的机器学习合成数据。
key_points: 目标是量化实际检验结果的可重复区间
结果可指导合成数据生成的真实性边界
同时提示临床医生检验误差范围
reason: 单中心预印本，方法有新意但证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Data from medical records are often limited in size, creating challenges for Artificial Intelligence training, and an opportunity for data augmentation techniques to create synthetic data. A natural question is how much data can be randomized and still be realistic. The main goal of this study is to attempt to measure the reproducibility of labs drawn in practice, so these ranges can be used for generating more realistic synthetic data. A second goal is to inform clinicians of the real error ranges of their laboratory data so these values may be better interpreted.
zh_abstract: 医疗记录中的数据规模往往有限，这给人工智能训练带来挑战，也为通过数据增强技术生成合成数据提供了机会。一个自然的问题是，有多少数据可以被随机化而仍然保持真实性。本研究的主要目标是尝试测量实践中采集的实验室检查结果的可重复性，以便这些范围可用于生成更真实的合成数据。第二个目标是让临床医生了解其实验室数据的真实误差范围，从而使这些数值能够得到更好的解读。

title: How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions
zh_title: 证据感知评估揭示标注覆盖对乳腺病变RAG检索分数的影响
summary: 预印本提出面向乳腺病变管理文献 RAG 系统的证据感知检索评估协议，并分析检索分数对标注覆盖的依赖。
key_points: 语料 18 篇文献、18 条查询，每篇对应一个问题
检索融合稠密向量、BM25 与交叉编码器重排
比较不同分块长度、重叠率与四种检索配置
reason: 小规模开发集上的检索评估方法预印本，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid retriever, using 384-token chunks and 20% overlap, retrieved accepted evidence in the top three results for 17 of 18 queries. Recall@3, R-Precision, MRR@3, and nDCG@3 each reached 0.94. Ground-truth curation increased evidence spans from 25 to 37 and accepted chunk targets from 36 to 51 without changing retrieval rankings. Conclusion: Cross-encoder reranking achieved the highest retrieval scores. Expanded relevance annotations increased recognized evidence without changing rankings, highlighting annotation sensitivity. The small development set and retrieval-informed curation require independent validation, including radiologist assessment of evidence sufficiency.
zh_abstract: 【目的】描述一种面向乳腺病变管理文献的临床检索增强生成（RAG）系统的证据感知检索评估方案，解决检索分数对标注覆盖度的依赖问题。【方法】使用包含 18 篇文档的语料库和包含 18 个查询的开发基准，每篇文档对应一个是/否问题或 WH 问题。检索结合了稠密嵌入、BM25 和交叉编码器重排序。评估了 128 至 1024 个 token 的块大小、0 至 20% 的重叠以及四种检索器配置。相关性由映射到所有包含该证据的块的证据片段定义，将具有等价证据的重叠块视为相关。检索使用 R-Precision、Recall@K、MRR 和 nDCG@K 进行评估。另外，在 512 token 索引上以 K=1 至 5 使用 DeepEval 论断级指标评估生成，以 deepseek-v4-pro 作为 LLM 评判器，并使用 BLEU/ROUGE 指标。【结果】所选混合检索器使用 384 token 块和 20% 重叠，在 18 个查询中的 17 个的前三结果中检索到被接受的证据。Recall@3、R-Precision、MRR@3 和 nDCG@3 均达到 0.94。真值整理将证据片段从 25 个增加到 37 个，将被接受的块目标从 36 个增加到 51 个，而未改变检索排名。【结论】交叉编码器重排序取得了最高的检索分数。扩展的相关性标注增加了被识别的证据而未改变排名，凸显了标注敏感性。小型开发集和受检索影响的整理需要独立验证，包括放射科医生对证据充分性的评估。

title: Multimodal biomarkers for early detection and immunotherapy assessment in hepatocellular carcinoma: integrating liquid biopsy, AI-based imaging and tumor immune profiling.
zh_title: 肝细胞癌多模态生物标志物与AI影像综述
summary: 综述按应用场景梳理HCC液体活检、AI影像与肿瘤免疫分析等生物标志物。
key_points: 按监测、分层与疗效评估等用途组织
涵盖cfDNA甲基化与片段组学
纳入AI影像与肿瘤免疫分析
reason: 结构化叙述综述，AI影像仅一部分，无原始数据，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) commonly develops in chronically diseased liver and remains challenging because of late detection, heterogeneity, recurrence and limited hepatic reserve. Immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-based combinations improve outcomes in advanced HCC, but durable responses occur in only a subset of patients. This structured narrative review evaluates biomarkers by intended use: surveillance and early detection, pretreatment prognostic stratification, treatment selection, on-treatment monitoring, neoadjuvant response assessment and postoperative minimal residual disease (MRD) detection. Serum alpha-fetoprotein and clinical scores are accessible but largely reflect tumor burden, inflammation or liver function. Cell-free DNA methylation and fragmentomics provide early-detection and tissue-of-origin signals, while circulating tumor DNA tracks molecular burden and clonal evolution. Tissue and spatial profiling clarify immune responsiveness and resistance, whereas radiomics and deep learning noninvasively assess whole-tumor and peritumoral heterogeneity. These modalities are complementary but require distinct evidence standards. Most early-detection studies use case-control or enriched cohorts, and most immunotherapy associations are retrospective, prognostic or monitoring-related. No biomarker yet supports routine selection among ICI regimens. Unlike modality-specific summaries, this review aligns each biomarker with a defined clinical decision and evidentiary category and proposes a longitudinal framework integrating baseline blood, imaging and tissue features with on-treatment dynamics, preoperative reassessment and postoperative molecular surveillance. Clinical translation requires standardized assays, representative multicenter cohorts, locked external validation and biomarker-guided trials demonstrating value beyond established criteria.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] 肝细胞癌（hepatocellular carcinoma, HCC）常发生于慢性病变肝脏，并且由于发现晚、异质性、复发和肝脏储备有限而仍具挑战性。基于免疫检查点抑制剂（immune checkpoint inhibitor, ICI）的联合方案改善了晚期 HCC 的结局，但持久缓解仅见于一部分患者。本结构化叙述性综述按预期用途评估生物标志物：监测与早期检测、治疗前预后分层、治疗选择、治疗中监测、新辅助治疗反应评估和术后微小残留病（minimal residual disease, MRD）检测。血清甲胎蛋白和临床评分易于获取，但主要反映肿瘤负荷、炎症或肝功能。游离 DNA 甲基化和片段组学提供早期检测和组织来源信号，而循环肿瘤 DNA 追踪分子负荷和克隆演化。组织和空间分析阐明免疫反应性和耐药性，而放射组学和深度学习无创评估全肿瘤和瘤周异质性。这些模态互补，但需要不同的证据标准。大多数早期检测研究使用病例对照或富集队列，大多数免疫治疗关联为回顾性、预后性或监测相关。尚无生物标志物支持在 ICI 方案之间进行常规选择。与按模态划分的总结不同，本综述将每种生物标志物与明确的临床决策和证据类别相对应，并提出一个纵向框架，将基线血液、影像和组织特征与治疗中动态、术前再评估和术后分子监测整合起来。临床转化需要标准化检测、具有代表性的多中心队列、锁定的外部验证，以及证明其价值超越现有标准的生物标志物指导试验。

title: Computational Profiling and Pathogenicity Assessment of VHL Missense Mutations
zh_title: VHL错义突变的计算分析与致病性评估
summary: 用AlphaMissense、FoldX和分子动力学评估VHL错义突变对蛋白稳定性及HIF结合的影响。
key_points: AlphaMissense提示60-200残基高致病性
突变分为折叠失稳与HIF结合破坏两类
脯氨酸替换带来显著结构应力
reason: 预印本，纯计算分析、无实验验证，方法常规，属增量档。
abstract: Mutations in the VHL tumor suppressor gene promote tumorigenesis by stabilizing HIF-1. In this study, we investigated the functional impact of VHL missense mutations using AlphaMissense pathogenicity scores, protein stability simulations, and molecular dynamics. AlphaMissense identified high pathogenicity scores for residues 60-200, including the {beta}-domain and HIF-binding domain, suggesting these regions are critical for VHL's tumor suppressor function. We categorized the mutations into two groups: those that primarily destabilize protein folding and those that likely disrupt VHL-HIF-1 binding. FoldX stability simulations revealed high {Delta}{Delta}G values for both groups, with proline substitutions exerting significant structural stress. Structural modeling confirmed that these mutations disrupt secondary structures, particularly {beta}-sheets. Molecular dynamics simulations showed that the VHL monomer is flexible and unstable in several regions, whereas the VHL-HIF complex, particularly the HIF-binding domain, exhibits enhanced stability. Mutational scanning revealed that bulky amino acid substitutions, such as tryptophan, cause notable destabilization. Interestingly, some mutations predicted to be structurally stable were still classified as pathogenic by AlphaMissense and validated in the literature, suggesting that pathogenicity may arise from subtle functional impairments rather than just structural instability. These findings underscore the value of combining machine learning, structural simulations, and experimental data to predict and interpret the pathogenicity of VHL mutations.
zh_abstract: VHL 肿瘤抑制基因的突变通过稳定 HIF-1 促进肿瘤发生。在本研究中，我们使用 AlphaMissense 致病性评分、蛋白质稳定性模拟和分子动力学研究了 VHL 错义突变的功能影响。AlphaMissense 识别出残基 60–200 的高致病性评分，包括 β 结构域和 HIF 结合结构域，提示这些区域对 VHL 的肿瘤抑制功能至关重要。我们将这些突变分为两组：主要使蛋白质折叠不稳定的突变，以及可能破坏 VHL-HIF-1 结合的突变。FoldX 稳定性模拟显示两组均具有高 ΔΔG 值，其中脯氨酸替换造成显著的结构应激。结构建模证实，这些突变破坏二级结构，尤其是 β-折叠。分子动力学模拟显示，VHL 单体在多个区域具有柔性和不稳定性，而 VHL-HIF 复合物，尤其是 HIF 结合结构域，表现出增强的稳定性。突变扫描显示，体积较大的氨基酸替换（如色氨酸）会导致显著不稳定。有趣的是，一些预测为结构稳定的突变仍被 AlphaMissense 归类为致病性，并在文献中得到验证，提示致病性可能源于细微的功能损害，而不仅仅是结构不稳定。这些发现强调了结合机器学习、结构模拟和实验数据来预测和解释 VHL 突变致病性的价值。

title: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Label-Efficient Gastric Cancer Detection and Intra-Tumour Progression Analysis
zh_title: 面向胃癌检测的标签高效对比学习框架

abstract: Gastric Cancer is among the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide. The complexity and variability of histopathological images pose significant challenges for both pathologists and computer-based diagnostics, creating a growing need for machine learning approaches capable of capturing meaningful representations from limited labelled data. Selfsupervised Contrastive Learning (CL) has demonstrated promising results in natural image analysis; however, its application to gastric cancer histopathology remains underexplored. This paper proposes an integrated CL framework built on a ResNet50 encoder trained under the NT-Xent objective, without reliance on ImageNet pre-training, to learn discriminative and staining-invariant representations from H&E-stained tissue patches. The learned embeddings are transferred to a supervised downstream classifier for binary tumour/normal (TUM/NOR) detection, achieving a test accuracy of 83.13%, an AUC-ROC of 0.9087, and an Average Precision of 0.9063 - competitive with recent supervised and weakly-supervised approaches on comparable histopathology benchmarks. Beyond binary diagnosis, the framework applies K-Means clustering to tumour embeddings to identify four geometrically separable pseudo-stage clusters, confirmed by a Random Forest classifier achieving 97% accuracy and a mean Dice coefficient of 0.97, demonstrating the capacity of CL representations to encode progression-relevant morphological variation without stage-level annotations. Grad-CAM explainability is integrated throughout to ensure model transparency. The complete system is deployed via a Streamlit clinical interface. Compared to recent state-of-the-art methods the proposed framework operates with substantially fewer labelled samples while additionally providing unsupervised progression stratification and interpretable outputs, addressing a gap not covered by existing approaches.
zh_abstract: 胃癌（Gastric Cancer）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。组织病理学图像的复杂性和变异性给病理学家和基于计算机的诊断带来重大挑战，这日益需要能够从有限标注数据中捕获有意义表示的机器学习方法。自监督对比学习（Selfsupervised Contrastive Learning, CL）在自然图像分析中已展现出良好结果；然而，其在胃癌组织病理学中的应用仍缺乏充分探索。本文提出一个集成的CL框架，该框架建立在以NT-Xent目标训练的ResNet50编码器之上，不依赖ImageNet预训练，用于从H&E染色组织切片块中学习具有判别性且对染色不变的表示。所学嵌入被迁移至监督式下游分类器，用于二分类肿瘤/正常（tumour/normal, TUM/NOR）检测，测试准确率达到83.13%，AUC-ROC为0.9087，平均精确率（Average Precision）为0.9063——在可比较的组织病理学基准上与近期监督式和弱监督方法具有竞争力。除二分类诊断外，该框架对肿瘤嵌入应用K-Means聚类，以识别四个在几何上可分离的伪分期簇，并由随机森林（Random Forest）分类器证实，其准确率达97%，平均Dice系数为0.97，表明CL表示能够在没有分期级标注的情况下编码与进展相关的形态学变异。全程整合Grad-CAM可解释性以确保模型透明性。完整系统通过Streamlit临床界面部署。与近期最先进方法相比，所提框架在标注样本显著更少的情况下运行，同时额外提供无监督进展分层和可解释输出，填补了现有方法未覆盖的空白。

abstract: Risk prediction models are frequently evaluated with AUC, which means that during evaluation we are blind to performance heterogeneity, which could lead to bad decision-making in clinics. In this work, we aim to change that by identifying patient cohorts for whom the risk prediction model might not be an accurate predictor. To separate these cohorts, we use a version of the weighted AUC, which we call Localized AUC or LAUC. Using this metric, we build a method that we coin LOCATOR. This method is able to identify cohorts of patients for whom the risk prediction model is inaccurate. We test this method both in real-world data and in simulations. We also build a statistical background for the use of Localized AUC for our purposes.

abstract: In this work, we propose Equivariant Experience Replay, a new paradigm for achieving continual learning of deep networks for solving ill-posed imaging inverse problems. Inspired by recent advances on unsupervised learning methods such as equivariant imaging/splitting, we find the exploitation of group-symmetry structure is particularly relevant and effective in continual learning setting for ill-posed inversion tasks. We therefore propose this new experience replay scheme, which is tailored for such inverse problems. Our numerical study demonstrates the superiority of our method compared to existing continual learning methods for inverse problems in medical imaging and image processing.

title: When Reconstruction Is Not Enough: Doubly Robust Counterfactual and Interventional Mediation Analysis with Learned Multimodal Representations

summary: 预印本提出：多模态健康记录的表征若以重建为目标训练，未必能保留因果识别所需信息。

abstract: Learned representations of high-dimensional multimodal health records are increasingly used to adjust for confounding, yet they are usually trained to reconstruct the data rather than preserve the information that causal identification requires. We study counterfactual outcomes under alternative treatments, including phenotype-specific effects and patient-level counterfactual risk profiles of the kind digital twins provide, and interventional direct and indirect effects under exposure-induced intermediate confounding. We give conditions under which a representation preserves identification and show that interventional mediation is more demanding than counterfactual comparison. We prove that no covariate-only training objective, whether reconstruction, contrastive, or physics-informed, can certify that a representation is sufficient, and that, in a linear structural model, a representation can lose arbitrarily little reconstruction accuracy yet induce arbitrarily large bias. We decompose the error of cross-fitted doubly robust estimators into a first-order representation bias, which neither double robustness nor cross-fitting removes, and a second-order remainder of nuisance-estimation errors, so coverage worsens as the sample size grows when the representation is insufficient. We propose a workflow combining modality-specific variational autoencoders trained outside the estimation sample, cross-fitted doubly robust estimators, locked phenotypes, select-then-confirm pathway analysis, portable representations, and diagnostics for representation insufficiency, exposure leakage, and sensitivity. In simulations, discarding a rare, moderately strong confounder gave indirect-effect intervals with 2% coverage at n = 3,000; reconstruction loss missed the problem, and a simple predictive diagnostic flagged it in every replicate.
zh_abstract: 高维多模态健康记录的学习表示正越来越多地用于校正混杂，但它们通常被训练来重建数据，而不是保留因果识别所需的信息。我们研究替代治疗下的反事实结局，包括表型特异性效应和数字孪生所提供的那类患者级反事实风险概况，以及暴露诱导的中间混杂下的干预性直接效应和间接效应。我们给出表示能够保持识别的条件，并表明干预性中介分析比反事实比较要求更高。我们证明，任何仅基于协变量的训练目标——无论是重建、对比还是物理信息目标——都不能证明表示是充分的；并且在线性结构模型中，表示可以损失任意小的重建精度，却引入任意大的偏倚。我们将交叉拟合双稳健估计器的误差分解为一阶表示偏倚（双稳健性和交叉拟合均不能消除它）以及干扰参数估计误差的二阶余项；因此当表示不充分时，覆盖率会随着样本量增大而变差。我们提出一种工作流程，结合在估计样本之外训练的模态特异性变分自编码器、交叉拟合双稳健估计器、锁定表型、先选择后确认的通路分析、可移植表示，以及针对表示不足、暴露泄漏和敏感性的诊断。在模拟中，丢弃一个罕见且中等强度的混杂因素，在 n = 3,000 时得到的间接效应区间覆盖率为 2%；重建损失未发现问题，而一个简单的预测性诊断在每次重复中都检出了问题。

abstract: [Revista da Associacao Medica Brasileira (1992)] The aim of this study was to evaluate the applicability of a smartphone-based portable fundus camera for diabetic retinopathy screening in elderly residents of a specialized shelter in São Paulo, Brazil, considering image acquisition by non-ophthalmologist professionals and remote case classification. Prospective pilot interventional study at the Centro de Acolhida Especial para Idosos Morada São João. Thirty-eight participants (76 eyes) underwent retinal imaging using the Eyer® portable fundus camera (Phelcom Technologies, Brazil) by trained non-ophthalmologist professionals. Images were remotely evaluated by a retinal specialist and compared to the EyerMaps® artificial intelligence system. Mean age was 71.6±7.0 years; 78.9% male. Fifteen participants (39.5%) had confirmed diabetes mellitus. The specialist identified abnormalities in 70 of 76 eyes (92.1%), most frequently glaucoma suspicion, media opacity suggestive of cataract, chorioretinal changes, and age-related macular degeneration signs; no diabetic retinopathy was identified. Against the specialist's assessment of any ocular abnormality as the reference standard, the artificial intelligence system classified 22 eyes as abnormal, yielding sensitivity 25.7% (95%CI 16.9-37.0), specificity 33.3% (95%CI 9.7-70.0), positive predictive value 81.8% (95%CI 61.5-92.7), negative predictive value 3.7% (95%CI 1.0-12.5), and overall accuracy 26.3% (95%CI 17.7-37.2). The Eyer® device demonstrated operational feasibility for ocular screening by trained non-ophthalmologists. The high prevalence of media opacities and non-diabetic retinopathy conditions compromised artificial intelligence performance, highlighting the need for broader screening strategies in elderly and socially vulnerable populations.
zh_abstract: [Revista da Associacao Medica Brasileira (1992)] 本研究旨在评估基于智能手机的便携式眼底照相机在巴西圣保罗一家专门收容机构老年居民中筛查糖尿病视网膜病变的适用性，并考虑由非眼科专业人员进行图像采集和远程病例分类。在Centro de Acolhida Especial para Idosos Morada São João进行前瞻性试点干预研究。38名参与者（76只眼）由接受过培训的非眼科专业人员使用Eyer®便携式眼底照相机（Phelcom Technologies，巴西）进行视网膜成像。图像由视网膜专科医生远程评估，并与EyerMaps®人工智能系统进行比较。平均年龄为71.6±7.0岁；78.9%为男性。15名参与者（39.5%）确诊糖尿病。专科医生在76只眼中的70只（92.1%）发现异常，最常见的是疑似青光眼、提示白内障的屈光介质混浊、脉络膜视网膜改变以及年龄相关性黄斑变性体征；未发现糖尿病视网膜病变。以专科医生对任何眼部异常的评估作为参考标准，人工智能系统将22只眼分类为异常，灵敏度为25.7%（95%CI 16.9–37.0），特异度为33.3%（95%CI 9.7–70.0），阳性预测值为81.8%（95%CI 61.5–92.7），阴性预测值为3.7%（95%CI 1.0–12.5），总体准确率为26.3%（95%CI 17.7–37.2）。Eyer®设备证明了由受过培训的非眼科专业人员进行眼部筛查在操作上的可行性。屈光介质混浊和非糖尿病视网膜病变疾病的高患病率损害了人工智能性能，突显了在老年和社会弱势人群中采用更广泛筛查策略的必要性。

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] The practice of artificial intelligence has recently expanded several social spheres, with the pharmaceutical domain leading the way. Given that AI can facilitate rational drug design, it is plausible to envision its involvement in developing pharmaceutical products from the laboratory to the patient's bedside. AI recognizes hit and lead compounds, followed by validation of therapeutic targets and optimization of molecular design. Artificial intelligence significantly impacts drug discovery and development processes, including target identification, molecule design, drug-drug interactions, drug repurposing, optimization of clinical trials, drug toxicity prediction, drug formulation, and delivery. AI-assisted approaches are progressively being employed for identification and prioritization of targets, biomarker discovery and virtual screening as well as prediction for the interaction of protein and ligand and their molecular properties followed by ADMET screening, molecular design and repurposing to be suited for clinical trial optimization. The significance of automation will be boosted by adopting the most recent artificial intelligence-based technologies, reducing the time it takes for drugs to be available in the market with improved quality, production process safety, and resource utilization. The application of artificial intelligence may not only aid in rapid decision-making but can also enhance the process of incorporating the newly discovered drug into the optimum dosage form, which leads to faster manufacturing of higher-quality drugs and ensures consistency among batches. The potential of artificial intelligence in drug discovery and development, has been explored in this review, encircling several stages from identification of target to its clinical applications, followed by drug development approaches encompassing the future of artificial intelligence in the pharmaceutical sector, along with crosstalk on the tools and tactics used to enforce artificial intelligence, current difficulties, and respective solutions.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] 人工智能的应用近来已扩展到若干社会领域，其中制药领域走在前列。鉴于人工智能能够促进合理药物设计，设想其参与从实验室到患者床旁的药品开发是合理的。人工智能识别命中化合物（hit）和先导化合物（lead），随后进行治疗靶点验证和分子设计优化。人工智能显著影响药物发现和开发过程，包括靶点识别、分子设计、药物–药物相互作用、药物重定位、临床试验优化、药物毒性预测、药物制剂和递送。人工智能辅助方法正逐步用于靶点的识别和优先级排序、生物标志物发现和虚拟筛选，以及预测蛋白质与配体的相互作用及其分子性质，随后进行 ADMET 筛选、分子设计和重定位，以适应临床试验优化。采用最新基于人工智能的技术将提升自动化的意义，缩短药物上市所需时间，同时提高质量、生产过程安全性和资源利用。人工智能的应用不仅可能有助于快速决策，还可能增强将新发现的药物纳入最佳剂型的过程，从而更快制造更高质量的药物并确保批次间一致性。本综述探讨了人工智能在药物发现和开发中的潜力，涵盖从靶点识别到其临床应用等多个阶段，随后讨论了涵盖人工智能在制药领域未来的药物开发方法，以及关于用于实施人工智能的工具和策略、当前困难及相应解决方案的交叉讨论。
